name: SOUTH AFRICA
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

South Africa dazzles with its incredible diversity—from Cape Town's stunning natural beauty to Kruger's Big Five safaris, wine regions' rolling vineyards to Johannesburg's urban energy. Experience dramatic coastlines, world-class wildlife viewing, rich cultural heritage, and the legacy of Nelson Mandela. From Table Mountain to the Garden Route, shark cage diving to township tours, South Africa offers adventure, luxury, and profound historical experiences in one remarkable nation.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Pretoria (administrative), Cape Town (legislative), Bloemfontein (judicial)  
**Currency:** South African Rand (ZAR)  
**Time Zone:** SAST (UTC+2)  
**Driving Side:** Left  
**Calling Code:** +27  
**Best Season:** Year-round (varies by region)  
**Languages:** 11 official languages including English, Afrikaans, Zulu, Xhosa

### Tourism Summary

South Africa attracts visitors with Cape Town's iconic Table Mountain and V&A Waterfront, Kruger National Park's Big Five safaris, the Garden Route's scenic beauty, and Johannesburg's Apartheid Museum. The country's wine regions, pristine beaches, diverse wildlife, and rich history create an unforgettable African experience combining natural wonders with world-class infrastructure.

---

## SOUTH AFRICA PACKAGES

packages.title: Cape Town & Garden Route
packages.overview: Discover South Africa's most scenic region where mountains meet ocean and charming towns dot the coastline. This journey combines Cape Town's iconic attractions with the Garden Route's natural beauty. Ascend Table Mountain, visit penguins at Boulders Beach, taste world-class wines, and drive one of the world's most beautiful coastal routes. Experience the perfect blend of urban sophistication and natural splendor.
highlights: Cape Point and Cape of Good Hope

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cape Town
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Arrive at Cape Town International Airport. Transfer to hotel with Table Mountain views.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore V&A Waterfront. Visit shops, restaurants, and harbor. Optional Two Oceans Aquarium.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at waterfront restaurant. Try Cape Malay curry and local wines.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Table Mountain & City Tour
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Ascend Table Mountain by cable car (weather permitting). Enjoy panoramic views of Cape Town, ocean, and mountains. Walk the summit trails.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): City tour including Company's Garden, Castle of Good Hope, Bo-Kaap's colorful houses, and Signal Hill viewpoint.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner in trendy Camps Bay with ocean views.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Cape Peninsula
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Full-day Cape Peninsula tour. Drive along Chapman's Peak scenic route. Visit Boulders Beach to see African penguins. Continue to Cape Point and Cape of Good Hope, the southwestern tip of Africa.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Return via Simon's Town. Optional visit to Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner at a seafood restaurant in Hout Bay.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Wine Country
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Drive to Stellenbosch wine region. Visit 2-3 wine estates for tastings. Learn about South African wine production. Enjoy Cape Dutch architecture.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue to Franschhoek, the gourmet capital. Wine tram experience or additional tastings. Lunch at a vineyard restaurant.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to Cape Town. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Garden Route - Hermanus & Mossel Bay
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Drive along the Garden Route. Stop in Hermanus for whale watching (June-November) or coastal views. Continue to Mossel Bay.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Arrive in Knysna. Check into hotel. Explore the lagoon and waterfront.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner at a Knysna restaurant. Try fresh oysters.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Knysna & Plettenberg Bay
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit Knysna Heads for dramatic ocean views. Explore Featherbed Nature Reserve or take a lagoon cruise.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Drive to Plettenberg Bay. Visit beautiful beaches. Optional activities: Monkeyland, Birds of Eden, or Robberg Nature Reserve hike.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner. Overnight in Plett or return toward Cape Town.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Departure
activities: Morning: Return drive to Cape Town (5 hours) or fly from George. Transfer to airport for departure.

packages.title: Kruger Safari & Cape Town
packages.overview: Experience the ultimate South African adventure combining world-class wildlife safaris with Cape Town's urban beauty. This comprehensive journey offers Big Five game viewing in Kruger National Park's vast wilderness, followed by Cape Town's iconic attractions and wine country. From dawn game drives to sunset over Table Mountain, this tour delivers Africa's most sought-after experiences in one unforgettable trip.
highlights: Kruger National Park Big Five safaris

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Johannesburg & Kruger
activities: Morning: Arrive in Johannesburg. Connect to flight to Kruger area (Hoedspruit or Skukuza).
Afternoon: Transfer to luxury safari lodge. Check-in and orientation. Afternoon game drive begins your safari adventure.
Evening: Sundowner drinks in the bush. Return to lodge for dinner under African stars.

itinerary.title: Day 2-3: Kruger Safari
activities: Each day follows safari rhythm:
Early Morning (5:30 AM - 9:00 AM): Dawn game drive when animals are most active. Search for Big Five (lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo, rhino). Bush breakfast or return to lodge.
Mid-Morning to Afternoon: Brunch. Leisure time at lodge - pool, spa, or rest.
Afternoon (3:30 PM - 7:00 PM): Afternoon game drive. Sundowner stop. Night drive with spotlight to see nocturnal animals.
Evening: Dinner at lodge. Share safari stories around the fire.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Kruger to Cape Town
activities: Morning: Final early game drive. Brunch at lodge. Transfer to airport.
Afternoon: Fly to Cape Town. Check into hotel. Evening at leisure to explore V&A Waterfront.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Cape Town - Table Mountain & City
activities: Full day exploring Cape Town (see Cape Town package Day 2 details). Table Mountain, city tour, Bo-Kaap.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Cape Peninsula
activities: Full-day Cape Peninsula tour (see Cape Town package Day 3 details). Penguins, Cape Point, scenic drives.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Wine Country
activities: Wine tasting day in Stellenbosch and Franschhoek (see Cape Town package Day 4 details).

itinerary.title: Day 8: Leisure Day
activities: Free day for optional activities: Robben Island, shark cage diving, helicopter flight, shopping, or beach relaxation.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Departure
activities: Transfer to Cape Town airport for departure.

name: MOROCCO
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

Morocco enchants with its exotic blend of Arab, Berber, and French influences, creating a sensory feast of colors, sounds, and flavors. From Marrakech's bustling souks to the Sahara's golden dunes, Fes's medieval medina to Casablanca's Hassan II Mosque, Morocco offers incredible diversity. Experience riads and palaces, spice markets and tanneries, Atlas Mountains and coastal towns. Morocco represents the gateway to Africa with a uniquely North African character.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Rabat  
**Currency:** Moroccan Dirham (MAD)  
**Time Zone:** WET (UTC+0)  
**Driving Side:** Right  
**Calling Code:** +212  
**Best Season:** March-May, September-November  
**Languages:** Arabic, Berber, French, English (in tourist areas)

### Tourism Summary

Morocco attracts visitors with Marrakech's Jemaa el-Fnaa square and souks, Fes's ancient medina, the blue city of Chefchaouen, Sahara Desert camel treks, and coastal Essaouira. The country's imperial cities, kasbahs, Atlas Mountains, and vibrant culture create an exotic North African experience. Moroccan hospitality, delicious cuisine, and diverse landscapes make it endlessly fascinating.

---

## MOROCCO PACKAGES

packages.title: Imperial Cities
packages.overview: Journey through Morocco's four imperial cities, each a former capital with unique character and architectural splendor. This cultural odyssey explores Marrakech's vibrant energy, Fes's medieval maze, Meknes's grand gates, and Rabat's modern elegance, plus Casablanca's iconic mosque. Experience Morocco's rich history, from Berber dynasties to French colonial influence, while staying in traditional riads and exploring ancient medinas.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Casablanca
activities: Arrive in Casablanca. Visit Hassan II Mosque, one of the world's largest mosques with ocean location. City tour. Transfer to Rabat. Check into hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Rabat & Meknes
activities: Morning: Explore Rabat - Hassan Tower, Mohammed V Mausoleum, Kasbah of the Udayas, and royal palace.
Afternoon: Drive to Meknes. Visit Bab Mansour gate, Moulay Ismail Mausoleum, and the imperial city. Continue to nearby Volubilis Roman ruins with impressive mosaics.
Evening: Arrive in Fes. Check into traditional riad.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Fes Medina
activities: Full day exploring Fes el-Bali, the world's largest car-free urban area and UNESCO World Heritage site. Navigate the labyrinthine medina with a local guide. Visit:
- Al-Qarawiyyin Mosque and University (world's oldest)
- Bou Inania Madrasa with intricate tilework
- Chouara Tannery with colorful dye pits
- Souks selling spices, leather, ceramics, and textiles
- Artisan workshops
Evening: Dinner at riad or rooftop restaurant overlooking the medina.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Fes to Marrakech via Middle Atlas
activities: Morning: Depart Fes. Drive through Middle Atlas Mountains. Stop in Ifrane, "Little Switzerland" with European architecture.
Afternoon: Continue through cedar forests (possible Barbary macaque sightings). Arrive in Marrakech. Check into riad in the medina.
Evening: First taste of Jemaa el-Fnaa square's evening energy - snake charmers, musicians, food stalls.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Marrakech Highlights
activities: Morning: Visit Bahia Palace with ornate rooms and gardens. Saadian Tombs with intricate decorations. Koutoubia Mosque (exterior).
Afternoon: Explore the souks - navigate the maze of markets selling everything from spices to carpets. Visit Ben Youssef Madrasa. Relax in Jardin Majorelle, Yves Saint Laurent's blue garden.
Evening: Dinner at a rooftop restaurant overlooking Jemaa el-Fnaa. Watch the square's nightly transformation.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Marrakech Leisure
activities: Morning: Optional activities - cooking class, hammam spa experience, or visit to Menara Gardens.
Afternoon: More souk exploration or relaxation at riad. Optional day trip to Atlas Mountains or Essaouira.
Evening: Farewell dinner with traditional Moroccan entertainment.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Marrakech to Casablanca
activities: Morning: Final Marrakech exploration or shopping.
Afternoon: Drive to Casablanca (3 hours). Check into hotel. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Departure
activities: Transfer to Casablanca airport for departure.

name: JAPAN
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

Japan mesmerizes with its seamless blend of ancient tradition and cutting-edge modernity. From Tokyo's neon-lit streets and Kyoto's golden temples to Mount Fuji's iconic peak and Osaka's culinary delights, Japan offers an experience unlike any other. Witness cherry blossoms in spring, experience tea ceremonies and geisha culture, ride bullet trains through stunning landscapes, and discover a nation where respect, precision, and beauty permeate every aspect of life. Japan's unique culture, exquisite cuisine, and warm hospitality create an unforgettable journey.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Tokyo  
**Currency:** Japanese Yen (JPY)  
**Time Zone:** Japan Standard Time (JST, UTC+9)  
**Driving Side:** Left  
**Calling Code:** +81  
**Best Season to Visit:** March-May (cherry blossoms), September-November  
**Languages Spoken:** Japanese, limited English

### Essential Travel Tips

**ATM & Banking:** 7-Eleven and post office ATMs accept international cards. Many ATMs don't accept foreign cards. Carry cash.

**Credit Cards:** Cash is still king in Japan. Many restaurants and shops only accept cash. Carry sufficient yen.

**Transportation:** Excellent train network including Shinkansen (bullet trains). JR Pass offers great value. Tokyo metro is extensive but complex. Taxis expensive.

**Safety:** Japan is extremely safe. Crime rates very low. Lost items often returned. Follow local customs and etiquette.

**Shopping:** Japan offers electronics, anime/manga goods, traditional crafts, cosmetics, and unique snacks. Tax-free shopping available.

**Cuisine:** Japanese food is exceptional. Try sushi, ramen, tempura, wagyu beef, and regional specialties. Tipping not customary and can be offensive.

**Public Transport:** Trains punctual and efficient. Purchase IC cards (Suica/Pasmo) for easy travel. Follow etiquette—no phone calls, eating, or loud talking.

**Weather:** Four distinct seasons. Spring (cherry blossoms) and fall (autumn colors) are peak seasons. Summer hot and humid. Winter cold in north.

### Tourism Summary

Japan stands as one of Asia's most fascinating destinations, offering an extraordinary blend of ancient temples, futuristic cities, and natural beauty. Travelers explore Tokyo's Shibuya Crossing and Senso-ji Temple, Kyoto's golden pavilions and geisha districts, Osaka's street food scene, and Hiroshima's peace memorial. Mount Fuji, cherry blossom viewing, hot spring resorts, and the Japanese Alps showcase natural splendor. The country's unique culture—from tea ceremonies to sumo wrestling, anime to traditional arts—combined with exceptional cuisine, efficient infrastructure, and respectful society creates a transformative travel experience.

---

## JAPAN TOUR PACKAGES

packages.title: Tokyo Modern Metropolis
packages.overview: Immerse yourself in Tokyo's electrifying energy where ancient shrines neighbor futuristic skyscrapers. This comprehensive Tokyo experience explores the world's largest metropolis, from the organized chaos of Shibuya Crossing to the serene beauty of Meiji Shrine, cutting-edge technology districts to traditional neighborhoods. Experience sushi at Tsukiji, shop in Harajuku, and discover why Tokyo represents the future while honoring its past. Perfect for first-time visitors seeking the ultimate urban Japanese experience.
highlights: Tokyo Skytree or Tokyo Tower views

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival & Shibuya
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Arrive at Narita or Haneda Airport. Transfer to your hotel in central Tokyo.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Shibuya. Experience the famous Shibuya Crossing, visit Hachiko statue, and explore the trendy shopping district. Walk to nearby Harajuku and Takeshita Street for youth fashion culture.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at an izakaya (Japanese pub) featuring yakitori, edamame, and sake.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Traditional Tokyo
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit Asakusa's Senso-ji Temple, Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple. Walk through Nakamise shopping street. Experience traditional Tokyo atmosphere.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore the Imperial Palace East Gardens. Visit the upscale Ginza district for shopping and architecture.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Sushi dinner at a traditional restaurant. Experience authentic Edomae sushi.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Modern Tokyo & Pop Culture
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit Tsukiji Outer Market for fresh seafood breakfast. Explore Akihabara, the electronics and anime district. Visit a maid café or anime shop.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Ascend Tokyo Skytree or Tokyo Tower for panoramic city views. Visit teamLab Borderless digital art museum for an immersive experience.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Explore Shinjuku's neon-lit streets. Visit the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building for free night views. Dinner in the entertainment district.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Day Trip Options
activities: Morning-Afternoon (9:00 AM - 6:00 PM): Choose from:
- Option 1: Nikko day trip to see ornate shrines and natural beauty
- Option 2: Kamakura for the Great Buddha and coastal temples
- Option 3: Hakone for Mount Fuji views and hot springs
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to Tokyo. Farewell dinner at a teppanyaki restaurant.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast. Last-minute shopping in Shibuya or Shinjuku.
Afternoon: Transfer to airport for departure.

packages.title: Kyoto Cultural Heritage
packages.overview: Discover Japan's ancient capital where 2,000 temples and shrines preserve centuries of tradition. This immersive Kyoto experience explores golden pavilions, zen gardens, geisha districts, and bamboo groves. Participate in a tea ceremony, walk through thousands of vermillion torii gates, and witness the changing seasons in temple gardens. From Fushimi Inari's mystical pathways to Arashiyama's natural beauty, experience the spiritual heart of Japan where every corner reveals timeless elegance.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival & Eastern Kyoto
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Arrive in Kyoto by Shinkansen or flight. Check into your hotel.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Higashiyama district. Visit Kiyomizu-dera Temple with its wooden stage and city views. Walk through the charming Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka streets.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Explore Gion, Kyoto's geisha district. Walk along Hanami-koji street hoping to spot a geisha or maiko. Traditional kaiseki dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Golden Pavilion & Zen Gardens
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit Kinkaku-ji, the stunning Golden Pavilion reflected in its pond. Continue to Ryoan-ji Temple to contemplate its famous zen rock garden.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Participate in a traditional tea ceremony. Learn about the ritual and philosophy. Visit Nijo Castle with its "nightingale floors" and beautiful gardens.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Explore Pontocho Alley, a narrow street lined with traditional restaurants. Dinner overlooking the Kamo River.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Fushimi Inari & Arashiyama
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit Fushimi Inari Shrine. Walk through thousands of vermillion torii gates winding up the mountain. Experience the mystical atmosphere.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Travel to Arashiyama. Walk through the enchanting Bamboo Grove. Visit Tenryu-ji Temple and its beautiful garden. Cross the Togetsukyo Bridge.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Check into a traditional ryokan. Experience kaiseki dinner and onsen (hot spring bath).

itinerary.title: Day 4: Nara Day Trip
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Day trip to Nara. Visit Todai-ji Temple housing the Great Buddha. Feed the friendly deer in Nara Park. Explore Kasuga Taisha Shrine with its lanterns.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Return to Kyoto. Free time for shopping in downtown Kyoto or visiting additional temples.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner at a traditional restaurant.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast. Optional visit to Nishiki Market, Kyoto's kitchen, for last-minute shopping.
Afternoon: Transfer to Kyoto Station or airport for departure.

name: THAILAND
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

Thailand captivates with its golden temples, tropical beaches, vibrant street life, and warm hospitality. From Bangkok's bustling markets and ornate palaces to Chiang Mai's mountain temples, Phuket's turquoise waters, and Krabi's limestone cliffs, Thailand offers diverse experiences. Savor world-renowned Thai cuisine, explore ancient ruins, experience elephant sanctuaries, and discover why Thailand is called the "Land of Smiles." The combination of rich culture, natural beauty, affordable luxury, and genuine friendliness makes Thailand Southeast Asia's most popular destination.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Bangkok  
**Currency:** Thai Baht (THB)  
**Time Zone:** Indochina Time (ICT, UTC+7)  
**Driving Side:** Left  
**Calling Code:** +66  
**Best Season to Visit:** November to February  
**Languages Spoken:** Thai, English (in tourist areas)

### Essential Travel Tips

**ATM & Banking:** ATMs widely available. Withdrawal fees apply. Exchange rates generally good at banks.

**Credit Cards:** Accepted in hotels and larger establishments. Cash preferred in markets and small restaurants.

**Transportation:** Tuk-tuks, taxis, and Grab app in cities. Domestic flights connect major destinations. Trains and buses available. Negotiate tuk-tuk prices before riding.

**Safety:** Generally safe. Watch for scams in tourist areas. Be respectful in temples. Avoid political discussions.

**Shopping:** Thailand offers silk, handicrafts, jewelry, and tailored clothing. Bargaining expected in markets.

**Cuisine:** Thai food is exceptional and affordable. Try pad thai, green curry, tom yum, mango sticky rice. Street food is safe and delicious. Tipping not mandatory but appreciated.

**Public Transport:** BTS Skytrain and MRT in Bangkok are efficient. Songthaews (shared trucks) common in smaller cities.

**Weather:** Hot year-round. Cool season (Nov-Feb) most pleasant. Hot season (Mar-May) very hot. Rainy season (Jun-Oct) has afternoon showers.

### Tourism Summary

Thailand attracts millions with its incredible diversity and value. Travelers explore Bangkok's Grand Palace and floating markets, Chiang Mai's temples and night bazaar, Phuket and Krabi's stunning beaches, Ayutthaya's ancient ruins, and Pai's bohemian mountain atmosphere. The country's islands—Koh Samui, Koh Phi Phi, Koh Tao—offer paradise beaches and diving. Thai massage, cooking classes, elephant sanctuaries, and vibrant nightlife add to the experience. Thailand's combination of culture, nature, cuisine, and affordability creates an accessible yet exotic destination.

---

name: ITALY
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

Italy captivates travelers with its extraordinary blend of ancient history, Renaissance masterpieces, and la dolce vita lifestyle. From the romantic canals of Venice to the eternal grandeur of Rome, every corner reveals centuries of artistic brilliance and cultural richness. The Italian experience weaves together world-class cuisine, stunning coastal landscapes, alpine adventures, and an unmatched passion for beauty and craftsmanship. Whether exploring Tuscan vineyards, wandering through medieval hilltop towns, or savoring authentic gelato in a sun-drenched piazza, Italy offers an intoxicating journey through time, art, and unforgettable flavors.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Rome  
**Currency:** Euro (EUR)  
**Time Zone:** Central European Time (CET, UTC+1)  
**Driving Side:** Right  
**Calling Code:** +39  
**Best Season to Visit:** April to June, September to October  
**Languages Spoken:** Italian, English (in tourist areas)

### Essential Travel Tips

**ATM & Banking:** ATMs are widely available in cities and towns. Most accept international cards. Notify your bank before traveling.

**Credit Cards:** Visa and Mastercard are widely accepted. Smaller establishments and rural areas may prefer cash.

**Transportation:** Italy has excellent train connections between major cities. Renting a car is ideal for exploring Tuscany and the Amalfi Coast. Taxis and ride-sharing apps are available in cities.

**Safety:** Italy is generally safe for tourists. Watch for pickpockets in crowded tourist areas, especially in Rome, Florence, and Venice.

**Shopping:** Italy is famous for leather goods, fashion, wine, and artisan crafts. Markets and boutiques offer authentic Italian products.

**Cuisine:** Italian cuisine varies by region. Don't miss authentic pizza in Naples, pasta in Rome, risotto in Milan, and gelato everywhere. Tipping is appreciated but not mandatory.

**Public Transport:** Metro systems in Rome and Milan are efficient. Buses and trams connect most areas. Purchase tickets before boarding.

**Weather:** Summers can be hot, especially in southern regions. Spring and fall offer pleasant temperatures. Winter is mild but can be rainy.

### Tourism Summary

Italy stands as one of the world's most beloved destinations, drawing millions with its unparalleled artistic heritage, iconic landmarks, and culinary excellence. Travelers immerse themselves in the Colosseum's ancient glory, marvel at Michelangelo's David, cruise Venice's enchanting canals, and bask in the Amalfi Coast's Mediterranean beauty. The country's diverse regions offer everything from alpine skiing in the Dolomites to wine tasting in Tuscany's rolling hills. Italy's magnetic charm lies in its ability to transport visitors through millennia of history while indulging them in contemporary luxury, making every moment feel like a scene from a timeless masterpiece.

---

This carefully curated journey takes you through Rome's legendary landmarks, from the mighty Colosseum to the sacred halls of Vatican City. Experience the grandeur of imperial Rome, toss a coin in the Trevi Fountain, and savor authentic Roman cuisine in charming trattorias. itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Rome
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Arrive at Rome Fiumicino Airport. Meet your tour coordinator and enjoy a comfortable transfer to your centrally located hotel. Check-in and freshen up.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Begin your Roman adventure with a leisurely walking tour of the historic center. Stroll through the charming streets to the iconic Trevi Fountain, where you'll toss a coin to ensure your return to Rome. Continue to the Spanish Steps and explore the elegant boutiques of Via Condotti.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a traditional Roman trattoria in the Trastevere neighborhood, featuring classic dishes like Cacio e Pepe and Carbonara paired with local wines.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Ancient Rome Exploration
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 12:00 PM): After breakfast, embark on a guided tour of the Colosseum, Rome's most iconic monument. Walk through the ancient amphitheater where gladiators once battled, then explore the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill, discovering the heart of the ancient empire.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit the magnificent Pantheon, one of Rome's best-preserved ancient buildings. Wander through Piazza Navona, admiring Bernini's stunning fountains. Enjoy free time for shopping or relaxing at a café.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Sunset stroll along the Tiber River. Dinner at leisure with recommendations from your guide for authentic Roman pizzerias.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Vatican City Wonders
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Early access tour of the Vatican Museums, including the breathtaking Sistine Chapel with Michelangelo's legendary ceiling frescoes. Continue to St. Peter's Basilica, marveling at its Renaissance architecture and climbing the dome for panoramic city views.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore the charming Trastevere district with its cobblestone streets, artisan workshops, and vibrant atmosphere. Visit the beautiful Basilica of Santa Maria in Trastevere.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Authentic Roman food tour featuring supplì, pizza al taglio, and gelato from local favorites. Experience Rome's culinary soul.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Hidden Gems & Leisure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Discover Rome's hidden treasures with visits to the Borghese Gallery's art collection or the atmospheric Catacombs. Alternatively, enjoy a leisurely morning exploring local markets.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Free time for personal exploration. Optional activities include visiting the Capitoline Museums, shopping in Campo de' Fiori market, or relaxing in Villa Borghese gardens.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner at a rooftop restaurant with stunning views of Rome's illuminated skyline.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Departure
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 11:00 AM): Final breakfast at the hotel. Depending on your flight time, enjoy last-minute souvenir shopping or a peaceful walk through the city.
Afternoon (12:00 PM onwards): Transfer to Rome Fiumicino Airport for your departure flight, carrying memories of the Eternal City.

Glide through Venice's mystical canals on a gondola, cross the iconic Rialto Bridge, and lose yourself in the labyrinth of narrow streets. Then travel to Florence, the cradle of the Renaissance, where Michelangelo's David, Botticelli's Birth of Venus, and Brunelleschi's Duomo await. itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Venice
activities: Morning (10:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Arrive at Venice Marco Polo Airport. Water taxi transfer to your elegant hotel near St. Mark's Square. Check-in and settle into your Venetian accommodation.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Orientation walking tour through Venice's enchanting streets. Cross the famous Rialto Bridge, explore the bustling Rialto Market, and wander through hidden campi (squares) discovering local artisan shops.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a canal-side restaurant featuring fresh seafood and Venetian specialties like Sarde in Saor and Risotto al Nero di Seppia.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Venice Highlights
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Guided tour of St. Mark's Basilica with its stunning Byzantine mosaics and golden interiors. Continue to the Doge's Palace, exploring the opulent chambers and crossing the legendary Bridge of Sighs.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Private gondola ride through Venice's romantic canals, gliding under ancient bridges and past Renaissance palaces. Your gondolier shares stories of Venetian history and traditions.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Free evening to explore. Enjoy aperitivo in St. Mark's Square with live music, or discover hidden bacari (wine bars) for cicchetti tasting.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Murano & Burano Islands
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Boat excursion to Murano Island, famous for centuries of glassmaking tradition. Watch master craftsmen create intricate glass art. Continue to colorful Burano Island with its rainbow-hued houses and lace-making heritage.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Return to Venice. Free time for shopping along the Mercerie or visiting the Peggy Guggenheim Collection of modern art.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Sunset views from the Accademia Bridge. Dinner featuring Venetian classics in a traditional osteria.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Transfer to Florence
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Breakfast and check-out. High-speed train journey through the Italian countryside to Florence, the Renaissance jewel of Tuscany.

Afternoon (1:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Arrive in Florence and check into your boutique hotel. Afternoon walking tour of the historic center, including Piazza della Signoria with its outdoor sculpture gallery and the iconic Ponte Vecchio bridge lined with jewelry shops.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome to Florence dinner at a traditional Florentine steakhouse, savoring the famous Bistecca alla Fiorentina.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Florence Renaissance Masterpieces
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Skip-the-line entry to the Uffizi Gallery, home to the world's finest collection of Renaissance art. Marvel at Botticelli's Birth of Venus, works by Leonardo da Vinci, Raphael, and Caravaggio. Continue to the Accademia Museum to stand before Michelangelo's magnificent David sculpture.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Climb the Florence Duomo for breathtaking panoramic views. Explore the Baptistery with its famous bronze doors and the Opera del Duomo Museum.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Sunset from Piazzale Michelangelo overlooking Florence's terracotta rooftops and the Arno River. Gelato tasting at a renowned gelateria.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Tuscan Wine & Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Half-day excursion to the Tuscan countryside for wine tasting at a traditional vineyard. Sample Chianti wines paired with local cheeses, olive oil, and bruschetta while enjoying rolling hill views.

packages.title: Amalfi Coast Paradise
packages.overview: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Italy's most spectacular coastline, where dramatic cliffs plunge into azure Mediterranean waters and pastel-colored villages cling to mountainsides. This luxurious journey takes you through the enchanting towns of Positano, Amalfi, and Ravello, with their cascading bougainvillea, lemon groves, and stunning coastal vistas. Cruise along the coast, savor fresh seafood, explore ancient ruins in Pompeii, and discover why the Amalfi Coast has captivated travelers for centuries.

Private boat tour to Capri's Blue Grotto

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival & Sorrento
activities: Morning (10:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Arrive at Naples Airport. Scenic transfer along the stunning coastal road to Sorrento, your base for exploring the Amalfi Coast. Check into your elegant hotel with sea views.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Sorrento's charming historic center with its narrow streets, artisan shops, and clifftop views. Visit a traditional limoncello factory to learn about this iconic lemon liqueur.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a terrace restaurant overlooking the Bay of Naples, featuring fresh seafood and local specialties.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Pompeii & Positano
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Guided tour of the ancient city of Pompeii, frozen in time by the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD. Walk through remarkably preserved streets, homes, and public buildings.

Afternoon (1:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue to Positano, the jewel of the Amalfi Coast. Descend the winding streets lined with boutiques and cafes. Relax on the beach or explore the colorful village cascading down the cliffside.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner in Positano with sunset views over the Mediterranean. Sample local dishes like Scialatielli ai Frutti di Mare.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Amalfi & Ravello
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Scenic coastal drive to the town of Amalfi. Visit the stunning Amalfi Cathedral with its Arab-Norman architecture. Explore the historic paper mills and charming piazzas.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Ascend to Ravello, perched high above the coast. Tour the magnificent Villa Rufolo and Villa Cimbrone with their legendary gardens offering breathtaking panoramic views of the coastline.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to your hotel. Evening at leisure to enjoy hotel amenities or stroll through Sorrento's evening atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Capri Island Excursion
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Private boat departure to the glamorous island of Capri. Cruise around the island, visiting the famous Blue Grotto where sunlight creates an ethereal blue glow in the sea cave. Dock at Marina Grande.

Afternoon (1:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Capri town with its designer boutiques and elegant piazzas. Take the chairlift to Monte Solaro for spectacular island views, or visit the Gardens of Augustus overlooking the Faraglioni rock formations.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to Sorrento by boat. Dinner featuring Caprese salad in its birthplace, paired with local wines.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Coastal Leisure & Hidden Gems
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Free morning to relax by your hotel pool, enjoy a spa treatment, or take a cooking class learning to make fresh pasta and tiramisu.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit the charming fishing village of Praiano or the ceramic town of Vietri sul Mare. Browse handcrafted ceramics and enjoy the slower pace of coastal life.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Sunset aperitivo at a clifftop bar. Farewell dinner at a Michelin-recommended restaurant showcasing modern Italian cuisine.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Path of the Gods Hike (Optional) & Relaxation
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 12:00 PM): For active travelers, guided hike along the famous Sentiero degli Dei (Path of the Gods) with spectacular coastal views. Alternatively, enjoy a leisurely morning exploring Sorrento's markets and shops.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Final afternoon to soak in the coastal beauty. Relax on a beach club, take a final swim in the Mediterranean, or enjoy a gelato while watching the sunset.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Casual dinner at a local pizzeria, savoring authentic Neapolitan pizza.

Savor farm-to-table cuisine, sample exceptional wines, and discover why Tuscany represents the essence of Italian beauty and la dolce vita.
highlights: Chianti wine region tours and tastings
Tuscan cooking class at a countryside villa

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Florence & Chianti
activities: Morning (10:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Arrive at Florence Airport. Scenic drive through the Chianti countryside to your charming agriturismo (farmhouse hotel) surrounded by vineyards and olive groves.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Settle into your rustic-elegant accommodation. Explore the property's grounds, perhaps taking a dip in the pool overlooking the Tuscan hills.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner featuring traditional Tuscan dishes prepared with ingredients from the estate's garden, paired with the property's own wines.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Chianti Wine Trail
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit two renowned Chianti wineries. Tour the cellars, learn about winemaking traditions, and taste Chianti Classico, Super Tuscans, and Vin Santo paired with local cheeses and cured meats.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore the charming village of Greve in Chianti with its triangular piazza and artisan shops. Visit a traditional butcher shop famous for its finocchiona salami.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to your agriturismo. Sunset aperitivo on the terrace with panoramic vineyard views.

itinerary.title: Day 3: San Gimignano & Volterra
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Journey to San Gimignano, the "Medieval Manhattan" famous for its 14 surviving towers. Wander through cobblestone streets, climb a tower for spectacular views, and taste the world's best gelato at Gelateria Dondoli.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue to Volterra, an ancient Etruscan hilltop town. Explore Roman ruins, medieval architecture, and alabaster workshops. Visit the dramatic Balze cliffs.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner at a family-run trattoria in the countryside, featuring pici pasta and wild boar ragù.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Siena & Val d'Orcia
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Discover Siena's magnificent Gothic architecture. Marvel at the shell-shaped Piazza del Campo and the stunning Siena Cathedral with its striped marble facade and intricate floor mosaics.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Drive through the UNESCO-listed Val d'Orcia, stopping in the postcard-perfect towns of Pienza (famous for pecorino cheese) and Montalcino (home of Brunello wine). Photo opportunities at the iconic Cappella della Madonna di Vitaleta.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Wine tasting and dinner in Montalcino, sampling the prestigious Brunello di Montalcino.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Tuscan Cooking Experience
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Hands-on cooking class at your agriturismo or a local villa. Learn to make fresh pasta, traditional sauces, and tiramisu from scratch. Shop for ingredients at a local market.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Enjoy the fruits of your labor with a leisurely lunch featuring the dishes you prepared. Free afternoon to relax, read in the garden, or take a countryside walk.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Optional truffle hunting experience with trained dogs, followed by a truffle-themed dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Departure via Florence
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast overlooking the Tuscan landscape. Transfer to Florence with time for last-minute shopping or a quick visit to Florence's Mercato Centrale.
Afternoon (1:00 PM onwards): Transfer to Florence Airport for departure, carrying the flavors and memories of Tuscany.

packages.title: Northern Italy Lakes & Alps
packages.overview: Discover the breathtaking beauty of Northern Italy where Alpine peaks meet crystalline lakes. This elegant journey showcases Lake Como's aristocratic villas, Lake Maggiore's island palaces, and the Dolomites' dramatic mountain scenery. Experience the perfect blend of Italian sophistication and natural splendor, from lakeside promenades to mountain cable car rides. Explore charming lakeside towns, cruise on pristine waters, and savor the unique culture where Italian warmth meets Alpine tradition.
highlights: Lake Como boat tour and Bellagio village

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Milan & Lake Como
activities: Morning (10:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Arrive at Milan Malpensa Airport. Transfer to Lake Como, one of Italy's most glamorous destinations. Check into your elegant lakeside hotel.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore the charming town of Como. Stroll along the lakefront promenade, visit the Como Cathedral, and ride the funicular to Brunate for panoramic lake views.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a lakeside restaurant featuring fresh lake fish and risotto, with views of the illuminated mountains.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Lake Como Highlights
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Private boat tour of Lake Como. Visit the stunning Villa del Balbianello with its terraced gardens and film-famous locations. Cruise past celebrity villas and picturesque villages.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Bellagio, the "Pearl of Lake Como." Wander through cobblestone streets, browse silk shops, and enjoy gelato overlooking the lake where its three branches meet.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to your hotel. Sunset aperitivo on your hotel terrace with Prosecco and lake views.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Lake Maggiore & Borromean Islands
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Transfer to Lake Maggiore. Board a boat to explore the magnificent Borromean Islands. Visit Isola Bella with its baroque palace and spectacular terraced gardens.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue to Isola dei Pescatori, a charming fishing village, and Isola Madre with its botanical gardens. Check into your Lake Maggiore hotel in Stresa.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner in Stresa's historic center, sampling Piedmontese cuisine and local wines.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Swiss Border & Alpine Scenery
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Scenic drive to the Swiss border region. Visit the picturesque town of Locarno or take a cable car ride for Alpine panoramas. Explore mountain villages with Swiss-Italian character.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Return through stunning mountain passes. Stop at a traditional Alpine rifugio (mountain hut) for lunch with spectacular views.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Relaxing evening at your hotel. Optional spa treatment or lakeside walk.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Milan City Experience
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Transfer to Milan. Guided tour of the magnificent Duomo, one of the world's largest Gothic cathedrals. Climb to the rooftop terraces for city views. Visit the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, Italy's oldest shopping arcade.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Milan's fashion district, the Quadrilatero della Moda. Visit Leonardo da Vinci's Last Supper (pre-booked). Stroll through the trendy Brera district.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Aperitivo in the Navigli canal district, followed by dinner at a contemporary Milanese restaurant.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Dolomites Day Trip
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Full-day excursion to the Dolomites UNESCO World Heritage site. Drive through spectacular mountain scenery with jagged peaks and Alpine meadows. Visit charming mountain towns like Cortina d'Ampezzo.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Cable car ride for breathtaking Dolomite panoramas. Lunch at a mountain restaurant with traditional South Tyrolean cuisine.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to Milan. Farewell dinner at a rooftop restaurant with Duomo views.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast. Depending on flight time, last-minute shopping in Milan's fashion boutiques or visit to Sforza Castle.
Afternoon (1:00 PM onwards): Transfer to Milan Malpensa Airport for departure.

imagePrompts: Elegant Villa del Balbianello on Lake Como with terraced gardens, cypress trees, and mountains reflected in calm blue water
Baroque palace and ornate Italian gardens of Isola Bella on Lake Maggiore with white peacocks and flowering terraces
Charming Bellagio village with colorful buildings along Lake Como waterfront and snow-capped Alps in background

packages.title: Sicily Cultural Discovery
packages.overview: Uncover the rich tapestry of Sicily, where Greek temples, Norman cathedrals, and Baroque palaces tell stories of millennia of civilizations. This comprehensive journey explores the island's diverse landscapes from Mount Etna's volcanic slopes to pristine Mediterranean beaches. Experience authentic Sicilian culture through its legendary cuisine, vibrant markets, and warm hospitality. From Palermo's bustling streets to Taormina's elegant terraces, discover why Sicily captivates with its unique blend of history, nature, and unforgettable flavors.
highlights: Valley of the Temples in Agrigento
Baroque towns of Noto and Ragusa
Sicilian cooking class and wine tasting

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Palermo
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Arrive at Palermo Airport. Transfer to your centrally located hotel in Sicily's vibrant capital.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Orientation walking tour of Palermo's historic center. Visit the stunning Palermo Cathedral, the Norman Palace with its Palatine Chapel's golden mosaics, and the lively Quattro Canti intersection.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a traditional Palermo restaurant featuring caponata, pasta con le sarde, and cannoli.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Palermo Markets & Monreale
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Immersive street food tour through Palermo's historic markets - Ballarò, Vucciria, and Capo. Taste arancini, panelle, sfincione, and other Sicilian specialties while experiencing the vibrant market atmosphere.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Short drive to Monreale to visit its magnificent cathedral, considered the finest example of Norman architecture with breathtaking Byzantine mosaics covering every surface.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Free evening to explore Palermo's nightlife or relax at a seaside café in Mondello.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Agrigento & Valley of the Temples
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Transfer to Agrigento. Guided tour of the Valley of the Temples, one of the most outstanding examples of ancient Greek architecture. Explore remarkably preserved temples including the Temple of Concordia.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue to your hotel in the Agrigento area. Visit the stunning Scala dei Turchi, a white limestone cliff formation rising from turquoise waters.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner featuring fresh seafood and local wines with sunset views over the Mediterranean.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Baroque Sicily - Ragusa & Noto
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Journey to Ragusa Ibla, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Explore its stunning Baroque architecture, winding streets, and beautiful churches perched on a hilltop.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue to Noto, the capital of Sicilian Baroque. Admire the golden limestone buildings, ornate balconies, and the magnificent Noto Cathedral. Transfer to Syracuse area.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Check into your Syracuse hotel. Dinner on the island of Ortigia, Syracuse's historic heart.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Syracuse & Ortigia
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Explore Syracuse's archaeological park with its Greek theater, Roman amphitheater, and the Ear of Dionysius cave. Visit the ancient ruins that rival those of Athens.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Wander through Ortigia island's charming streets. Visit the stunning Duomo built into an ancient Greek temple, the Arethusa Fountain, and browse artisan workshops.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Seafood dinner at a waterfront restaurant watching the sunset over the Ionian Sea.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Taormina & Mount Etna
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Transfer to Mount Etna, Europe's highest active volcano. Ascend by cable car and 4x4 vehicle to explore lunar landscapes, volcanic craters, and lava fields with spectacular views.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue to Taormina, Sicily's most elegant resort town. Check into your hotel with views of Mount Etna and the sea.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Stroll along Corso Umberto, Taormina's main street lined with boutiques and cafes. Dinner at a terrace restaurant with panoramic views.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Taormina Leisure & Culture
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit Taormina's ancient Greek Theater with its breathtaking backdrop of Mount Etna and the coastline. Explore the beautiful public gardens, Villa Comunale.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Free time to relax on Isola Bella beach, shop for ceramics and local products, or take a cooking class learning to make Sicilian specialties.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner featuring Sicilian wines and traditional dishes, celebrating your island journey.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast with views. Transfer to Catania Airport for departure.
Afternoon (1:00 PM onwards): Depart Sicily with memories of its ancient wonders and culinary delights.

name: FRANCE
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

France enchants travelers with its unparalleled elegance, from the romantic boulevards of Paris to the lavender fields of Provence and the glamorous beaches of the French Riviera. This nation of art, fashion, and gastronomy offers an intoxicating blend of world-class museums, Gothic cathedrals, Renaissance châteaux, and charming medieval villages. Whether sipping champagne in Reims, exploring Mont Saint-Michel's island abbey, or skiing in the French Alps, France delivers sophistication and beauty at every turn. The French art de vivre—the art of living well—permeates every experience, from Michelin-starred dining to simple café moments watching the world go by.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Paris  
**Currency:** Euro (EUR)  
**Time Zone:** Central European Time (CET, UTC+1)  
**Driving Side:** Right  
**Calling Code:** +33  
**Best Season to Visit:** April to June, September to October  
**Languages Spoken:** French, English (in tourist areas)

### Essential Travel Tips

**ATM & Banking:** ATMs are widely available throughout France. Most accept international cards. Inform your bank of travel plans.

**Credit Cards:** Visa and Mastercard are widely accepted. Chip-and-PIN cards are standard. Smaller establishments may prefer cash.

**Transportation:** France has an excellent high-speed train network (TGV) connecting major cities. Metro systems in Paris and Lyon are efficient. Car rentals are ideal for exploring countryside regions like Provence and Normandy.

**Safety:** France is generally safe for tourists. Be vigilant against pickpockets in Paris, especially near major attractions and on public transport. Keep valuables secure.

**Shopping:** France is renowned for fashion, perfumes, wine, cheese, and artisan goods. Paris offers luxury shopping on the Champs-Élysées and boutiques in Le Marais. Markets are excellent for local products.

**Cuisine:** French cuisine is world-famous. Don't miss croissants, baguettes, cheese, wine, escargot, coq au vin, and crème brûlée. Service charge is included in bills, but small tips are appreciated.

**Public Transport:** Paris Metro is extensive and efficient. Purchase a Navigo pass or carnet of tickets. Buses and trams serve most cities. Validate tickets before boarding.

**Weather:** Summers are warm, especially in the south. Spring and fall offer pleasant temperatures. Winter can be cold in the north and ideal for skiing in the Alps.

### Tourism Summary

France reigns as the world's most visited country, captivating travelers with its iconic landmarks, artistic heritage, and culinary excellence. Visitors flock to the Eiffel Tower, Louvre Museum, and Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris, cruise through Bordeaux's vineyards, marvel at Versailles' opulence, and bask in the Mediterranean sunshine of Nice and Cannes. From the D-Day beaches of Normandy to the fairy-tale châteaux of the Loire Valley, France offers endless discoveries. The country's regional diversity—from Brittany's Celtic culture to Alsace's Germanic influences—ensures every journey reveals new facets of French charm, making it an eternally enchanting destination.

---

## FRANCE TOUR PACKAGES

packages.title: Paris Romantic Escape
packages.overview: Fall in love with the City of Light on this enchanting Parisian journey. Experience the magic of the Eiffel Tower sparkling at night, world-renowned art at the Louvre, and the bohemian charm of Montmartre. Cruise the Seine River, stroll through elegant gardens, and savor exquisite French cuisine in intimate bistros. This carefully crafted package captures Paris's timeless romance, artistic soul, and sophisticated elegance, perfect for couples, art lovers, and anyone seeking the quintessential Parisian experience.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Paris
activities: Morning (10:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Arrive at Charles de Gaulle Airport. Private transfer to your elegant hotel in the heart of Paris. Check-in and settle into your Parisian accommodation.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Orientation walking tour through the charming streets of Le Marais district. Explore Place des Vosges, browse boutiques, and visit the historic Jewish quarter.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a traditional Parisian bistro featuring French onion soup, coq au vin, and crème brûlée paired with Bordeaux wine.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Iconic Paris
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Skip-the-line entry to the Louvre Museum. Guided tour of masterpieces including the Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, and Winged Victory. Explore the museum's magnificent galleries and Egyptian antiquities.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Stroll through the Tuileries Gardens to Place de la Concorde. Walk along the Champs-Élysées to the Arc de Triomphe. Climb to the top for panoramic Paris views.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Visit the Eiffel Tower at sunset. Ascend to the summit for breathtaking views. Toast with champagne as the tower begins its hourly light show.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Versailles & Left Bank
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Half-day excursion to the Palace of Versailles. Explore the opulent State Apartments, Hall of Mirrors, and magnificent gardens. Learn about Louis XIV's extravagant court life.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Return to Paris. Explore the Left Bank's Saint-Germain-des-Prés neighborhood. Visit the historic Café de Flore and Les Deux Magots. Browse Shakespeare and Company bookstore.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Romantic Seine River dinner cruise. Glide past illuminated landmarks including Notre-Dame, the Louvre, and the Eiffel Tower while enjoying gourmet French cuisine.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Montmartre & Culture
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Discover the artistic neighborhood of Montmartre. Visit the stunning Sacré-Cœur Basilica with its white domes. Explore Place du Tertre where artists paint portraits. Walk past the Moulin Rouge.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit the Musée d'Orsay housed in a beautiful Beaux-Arts railway station. Admire Impressionist masterpieces by Monet, Renoir, Van Gogh, and Degas.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): French pastry tour through Paris's finest patisseries. Taste macarons from Ladurée, éclairs, tarts, and other delicate French sweets.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast at a Parisian café with croissants and café au lait. Last-minute shopping or visit to the Luxembourg Gardens.
Afternoon (1:00 PM onwards): Transfer to Charles de Gaulle Airport for departure, carrying memories of Paris's timeless charm.

Ornate Hall of Mirrors at Versailles Palace with crystal chandeliers, gilded sculptures, and arched windows

packages.title: French Riviera Glamour
packages.overview: Experience the dazzling allure of the Côte d'Azur, where azure Mediterranean waters meet Belle Époque elegance. This luxurious journey takes you through the French Riviera's most glamorous destinations—from Nice's Promenade des Anglais to Monaco's legendary casino and Cannes' film festival glamour. Discover charming hilltop villages, pristine beaches, and world-class art museums. Savor Mediterranean cuisine, cruise along the stunning coastline, and immerse yourself in the sophisticated lifestyle that has attracted artists, royalty, and celebrities for over a century.
highlights: Nice's Old Town and Promenade des Anglais
Monaco's Monte Carlo Casino and Prince's Palace
Cannes' La Croisette and film festival atmosphere
Private yacht cruise along the coast

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nice
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Arrive at Nice Côte d'Azur Airport. Transfer to your elegant beachfront hotel on the Promenade des Anglais.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Nice's charming Old Town (Vieux Nice) with its narrow streets, colorful buildings, and bustling Cours Saleya market. Visit the stunning Russian Orthodox Cathedral.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a Mediterranean restaurant overlooking the Baie des Anges, featuring fresh seafood and Provençal specialties.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Nice Highlights & Art
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit the Matisse Museum showcasing the artist's vibrant works. Climb Castle Hill for panoramic views of Nice's terracotta rooftops and the azure coastline.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Stroll along the iconic Promenade des Anglais. Relax on a private beach club with loungers and Mediterranean views. Optional water sports or simply soak in the Riviera sunshine.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Sunset aperitivo at a rooftop bar. Dinner in the trendy Port area with views of luxury yachts.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Monaco & Monte Carlo
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Scenic coastal drive to the Principality of Monaco. Visit the Prince's Palace and watch the changing of the guard. Explore Monaco-Ville's charming old town and the Oceanographic Museum.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Experience the legendary Monte Carlo Casino with its Belle Époque architecture. Stroll through the exotic gardens and admire supercars parked along Casino Square. Walk through the luxurious boutiques.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Monaco, followed by optional evening at the casino or a walk through the illuminated harbor.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Cannes & Îles de Lérins
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Transfer to Cannes. Walk the famous La Croisette boulevard lined with palm trees, luxury hotels, and designer boutiques. Climb the steps of the Palais des Festivals where film stars walk the red carpet.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Boat excursion to the Îles de Lérins. Visit Sainte-Marguerite Island with its fort and pristine beaches. Enjoy swimming in crystal-clear waters and a picnic lunch.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to Cannes. Explore Le Suquet, the old quarter with its winding streets and panoramic views. Dinner at a harbor-side restaurant.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Hilltop Villages & Art
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Journey to Saint-Paul-de-Vence, one of France's most beautiful medieval villages. Wander through art galleries, artisan shops, and ancient ramparts. Visit the renowned Fondation Maeght modern art museum.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue to Antibes. Explore the Picasso Museum housed in the Château Grimaldi. Stroll through the charming old town and visit the impressive Fort Carré.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to Nice. Free evening to explore or relax at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Private Yacht & Coastal Beauty
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Private yacht cruise along the French Riviera coastline. Sail past Cap Ferrat's luxurious villas, anchor in secluded coves for swimming, and enjoy champagne on deck with stunning coastal views.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit Èze, a spectacular hilltop village perched 400 meters above the sea. Explore its medieval streets and the exotic garden with panoramic Mediterranean views. Visit a perfumery to learn about fragrance creation.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner at a cliffside restaurant in Èze or Nice, celebrating your Riviera journey with Provençal cuisine and local rosé wine.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast with sea views. Last stroll along the Promenade or shopping for Provençal products.
Afternoon (1:00 PM onwards): Transfer to Nice Airport for departure.

packages.title: Loire Valley Châteaux
packages.overview: Step into a fairy tale as you explore the magnificent châteaux of the Loire Valley, France's royal heartland. This enchanting journey takes you through Renaissance palaces, medieval fortresses, and elegant gardens that tell stories of French kings, queens, and nobility. Discover Leonardo da Vinci's final home, cruise the Loire River, and taste exceptional wines in historic cellars. From Chambord's architectural grandeur to Chenonceau's romantic arches spanning the river, experience the splendor of France's château country combined with world-class gastronomy and wine.
highlights: Château de Chenonceau spanning the Cher River
Leonardo da Vinci's Clos Lucé residence
Hot air balloon ride over châteaux (optional)

itinerary.title: Day 1: Paris to Loire Valley
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Depart Paris by private vehicle. Scenic drive through the French countryside to the Loire Valley, stopping at charming villages along the way.
Afternoon (1:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Arrive in the Loire Valley. Check into your elegant château hotel or manor house. Explore the property's grounds and gardens.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at your château featuring regional specialties and Loire Valley wines.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Chambord & Cheverny
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit the magnificent Château de Chambord, the largest château in the Loire Valley. Marvel at its distinctive French Renaissance architecture, double-helix staircase attributed to Leonardo da Vinci, and vast hunting grounds.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue to Château de Cheverny, still inhabited by the same family for six centuries. Explore its beautifully furnished rooms and kennels housing hunting dogs. The château inspired Hergé's Tintin comics.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to your accommodation. Dinner at a local restaurant featuring game dishes and regional wines.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Chenonceau & Amboise
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Discover Château de Chenonceau, the "Ladies' Château," gracefully spanning the Cher River with its elegant arches. Explore its Renaissance rooms, art collection, and magnificent gardens designed by Diane de Poitiers and Catherine de Medici.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit the royal Château d'Amboise with its Gothic and Renaissance architecture. Explore Leonardo da Vinci's tomb in the chapel. Continue to Clos Lucé, Leonardo's final residence, featuring models of his inventions.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Stroll through the charming town of Amboise. Dinner at a riverside restaurant.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Villandry Gardens & Wine Tasting
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit Château de Villandry, renowned for its spectacular Renaissance gardens. Explore the ornamental kitchen garden, water garden, and decorative flower beds arranged in geometric patterns.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Wine tasting experience at prestigious Loire Valley vineyards. Sample Sancerre, Vouvray, and Chinon wines while learning about the region's winemaking traditions. Tour ancient wine cellars carved into limestone cliffs.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to your château. Gourmet dinner featuring local produce paired with the wines you discovered.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Azay-le-Rideau & Chinon
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit Château d'Azay-le-Rideau, a jewel of Renaissance architecture reflected in its surrounding moat. Explore its elegant interiors and English-style park.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Return to Paris

packages.title: Provence Lavender & Villages
packages.overview: Immerse yourself in the enchanting beauty of Provence, where endless lavender fields meet medieval hilltop villages and Roman ruins. This sensory journey captures the essence of southern France—fragrant herbs, golden sunlight, vibrant markets, and the relaxed Provençal lifestyle. Explore charming villages like Gordes and Roussillon, discover ancient Roman monuments in Arles and Avignon, and savor the region's exceptional cuisine and wines. From lavender-scented valleys to ochre cliffs and olive groves, experience the magical landscape that inspired Van Gogh, Cézanne, and countless artists.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Provence
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Arrive at Marseille Airport. Transfer through the scenic Provençal countryside to your charming hotel or traditional mas (farmhouse) in the Luberon region.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Settle into your accommodation. Explore the property's gardens with lavender, rosemary, and olive trees. Relax by the pool with views of the countryside.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner featuring Provençal specialties like ratatouille, bouillabaisse, and tapenade, paired with local rosé wine.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Luberon Villages
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit Gordes, one of France's most beautiful villages perched dramatically on a hilltop. Explore its stone houses, art galleries, and the nearby Sénanque Abbey surrounded by lavender fields (best June-July).

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Discover Roussillon, famous for its ochre cliffs and buildings in shades of red, orange, and yellow. Walk the Ochre Trail through stunning geological formations. Continue to the charming village of Lourmarin.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to your hotel. Dinner at a local restaurant or your hotel's terrace under the stars.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Avignon & Châteauneuf-du-Pape
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Explore Avignon, the City of Popes. Visit the magnificent Papal Palace, one of Europe's largest Gothic buildings. Walk across the famous Pont d'Avignon bridge and explore the charming old town.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Wine tasting in Châteauneuf-du-Pape, one of France's most prestigious wine regions. Visit renowned wineries, tour cellars, and sample exceptional red wines while learning about the unique terroir.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner in Avignon featuring regional cuisine and Châteauneuf-du-Pape wines.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Arles & Camargue
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Discover Arles, the city that inspired Van Gogh. Visit the remarkably preserved Roman amphitheater and theater. Explore the charming old town and follow in Van Gogh's footsteps to locations he painted.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Excursion to the Camargue region, a unique wetland area. Spot wild white horses, pink flamingos, and black bulls. Visit a traditional manade (ranch) and learn about Camargue cowboys.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to your hotel. Relaxing evening with optional spa treatment.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Lavender & Markets
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit the Valensole Plateau's endless lavender fields (best mid-June to mid-July). Photo opportunities in the purple landscapes. Tour a lavender distillery to learn about essential oil production.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Experience a traditional Provençal market in a local village. Browse stalls selling fresh produce, herbs, cheeses, olives, and artisan crafts. Cooking class featuring Provençal recipes using market ingredients.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Enjoy the meal you prepared during the cooking class, paired with local wines.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Aix-en-Provence & Leisure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit elegant Aix-en-Provence, Cézanne's hometown. Stroll along the tree-lined Cours Mirabeau with its fountains and cafés. Visit Cézanne's studio and explore the charming old town.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Free time to relax at your hotel, enjoy the pool, or explore nearby villages. Optional visit to a local olive oil mill for tasting.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner at a Michelin-recommended restaurant, celebrating Provençal flavors and your journey through this magical region.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast with Provençal pastries. Last moments enjoying the countryside views.
Afternoon (1:00 PM onwards): Transfer to Marseille Airport for departure.

packages.title: Normandy & Brittany Discovery
packages.overview: Journey through the historic and scenic regions of Normandy and Brittany, where dramatic coastlines meet medieval towns and poignant World War II history. This comprehensive tour takes you from the D-Day landing beaches to Mont Saint-Michel's island abbey, through charming fishing villages and Celtic landscapes. Experience the region's rich maritime heritage, sample fresh seafood and crepes, and discover the unique culture where French tradition blends with Celtic influences. From Monet's gardens to ancient standing stones, this journey reveals northern France's diverse treasures.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Paris to Normandy via Giverny
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Depart Paris. Stop in Giverny to visit Claude Monet's house and gardens. Walk through the famous water lily pond and Japanese bridge that inspired his masterpieces.

Afternoon (1:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue to Normandy. Check into your hotel in the Bayeux area. Visit the remarkable Bayeux Tapestry, a 70-meter embroidered cloth depicting the Norman conquest of England.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner featuring Norman specialties like Camembert cheese, cider, and Calvados apple brandy.

itinerary.title: Day 2: D-Day Beaches & History
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Comprehensive tour of the D-Day landing beaches. Visit Omaha Beach, the American Cemetery with its rows of white crosses, and Pointe du Hoc where Rangers scaled the cliffs.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore the Caen Memorial Museum for deeper understanding of World War II and the Battle of Normandy. Visit additional landing sites like Utah Beach or Gold Beach.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Reflective evening. Dinner at a local restaurant honoring the region's history.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Mont Saint-Michel
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Journey to the iconic Mont Saint-Michel, the spectacular island abbey rising from the bay. Guided tour of the medieval abbey with its Gothic spires, cloisters, and stunning views. Explore the narrow streets lined with shops and restaurants.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Free time to experience Mont Saint-Michel at your own pace. Watch the dramatic tides that surround the island. Cross into Brittany and check into your hotel in Saint-Malo.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Explore Saint-Malo's impressive walled city. Dinner featuring fresh seafood and Breton galettes (savory buckwheat crepes).

itinerary.title: Day 4: Saint-Malo & Dinan
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Walk the ramparts of Saint-Malo with panoramic sea views. Explore the historic corsair city, visit the castle, and learn about the city's maritime history and famous explorers.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit the perfectly preserved medieval town of Dinan. Wander through cobblestone streets lined with half-timbered houses, artisan shops, and the impressive castle. Walk down to the charming port on the Rance River.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to Saint-Malo. Sunset walk on the beach. Dinner at a creperie with traditional Breton cider.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Brittany Coast & Carnac
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Drive along Brittany's stunning Pink Granite Coast with its unique rock formations. Stop at picturesque fishing villages and lighthouses.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit Carnac's mysterious megalithic sites with over 3,000 standing stones dating back to prehistoric times. Explore the alignments and learn about their enigmatic purpose.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Check into your hotel in the Quiberon or Vannes area. Dinner featuring Breton specialties like kouign-amann pastry.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Vannes & Return Journey
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Explore the charming medieval town of Vannes with its well-preserved ramparts, half-timbered houses, and beautiful port. Visit the Cathedral and stroll through the old town.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Begin the return journey toward Paris or your departure city. Stop at a traditional cider farm for tasting of Normandy ciders and Calvados.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Arrive in Paris area. Farewell dinner celebrating your Normandy and Brittany discoveries.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast. Transfer to Paris airport for departure.
