name: SWITZERLAND
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

Switzerland captivates with its pristine Alpine beauty, where snow-capped peaks tower above crystal-clear lakes and charming villages dot emerald valleys. This nation of precision and natural splendor offers an unparalleled blend of outdoor adventure, sophisticated cities, and timeless traditions. From the Matterhorn's iconic pyramid to the elegant shores of Lake Geneva, Switzerland delivers breathtaking scenery at every turn. Experience world-class skiing, scenic train journeys through mountain passes, medieval old towns, and the finest chocolate and cheese. Whether exploring cosmopolitan Zurich, French-speaking Geneva, or car-free Zermatt, Switzerland promises unforgettable Alpine magic combined with Swiss efficiency and hospitality.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Bern  
**Currency:** Swiss Franc (CHF)  
**Time Zone:** Central European Time (CET, UTC+1)  
**Driving Side:** Right  
**Calling Code:** +41  
**Best Season to Visit:** June to September (summer), December to March (skiing)  
**Languages Spoken:** German, French, Italian, Romansh, English

### Essential Travel Tips

**ATM & Banking:** ATMs are widely available and accept international cards. Switzerland is expensive; budget accordingly. Credit cards are widely accepted.

**Credit Cards:** Visa and Mastercard are accepted almost everywhere. Contactless payment is common. Some places still prefer cash for small purchases.

**Transportation:** Switzerland has one of the world's best public transport systems. Trains are punctual, clean, and scenic. Consider the Swiss Travel Pass for unlimited travel. Cable cars and mountain railways access Alpine peaks.

**Safety:** Switzerland is one of the world's safest countries. Crime rates are very low. Mountain activities require proper preparation and equipment.

**Shopping:** Switzerland is famous for watches, chocolate, cheese, and Swiss Army knives. Prices are high but quality is exceptional. Sunday shopping is limited.

**Cuisine:** Don't miss fondue, raclette, rösti, and Swiss chocolate. Tap water is safe and excellent. Tipping is included in bills but rounding up is appreciated.

**Public Transport:** Trains, buses, and boats are integrated and efficient. Purchase tickets before boarding. The Swiss Travel Pass offers great value for tourists.

**Weather:** Mountain weather changes rapidly. Bring layers. Summers are pleasant but can be cool at altitude. Winter is ideal for skiing. Spring and fall offer fewer crowds.

### Tourism Summary

Switzerland stands as a premier destination for travelers seeking Alpine perfection and outdoor adventure. Visitors are drawn to the Jungfraujoch "Top of Europe," the Matterhorn's majestic peak, scenic train journeys like the Glacier Express, and pristine lakes such as Geneva, Lucerne, and Interlaken. The country's efficient infrastructure makes exploring effortless, while its diverse regions offer distinct experiences—from German-speaking Zurich's urban sophistication to French-speaking Geneva's international flair and Italian-speaking Ticino's Mediterranean charm. Switzerland's combination of natural beauty, precision engineering, cultural richness, and world-class hospitality creates an Alpine paradise that enchants visitors year-round.

---

## SWITZERLAND TOUR PACKAGES

packages.title: Swiss Alpine Discovery
packages.overview: Experience the ultimate Swiss Alpine adventure, journeying through the country's most spectacular mountain landscapes and charming towns. This comprehensive tour takes you to the Jungfraujoch "Top of Europe," the iconic Matterhorn, and scenic mountain passes aboard legendary Swiss trains. Discover the elegance of Lucerne, the adventure capital of Interlaken, and the car-free village of Zermatt. Cruise pristine lakes, ride cable cars to breathtaking viewpoints, and immerse yourself in Swiss culture. This perfectly paced journey captures the essence of Switzerland's natural beauty and Alpine charm.
highlights: Mt. Titlis Rotair cable car experience

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zurich & Lucerne
activities: Morning (10:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Arrive at Zurich Airport. Scenic train journey to Lucerne, Switzerland's most picturesque city. Check into your lakeside hotel.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Lucerne's charming old town. Walk across the iconic Chapel Bridge with its painted panels, visit the poignant Lion Monument, and stroll along the lake promenade.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a traditional Swiss restaurant featuring fondue and local wines, with views of the illuminated bridge and mountains.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Mt. Titlis & Lake Lucerne
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Excursion to Mt. Titlis via the world's first rotating cable car, the Rotair. Experience the Glacier Cave, walk across the Cliff Walk suspension bridge, and enjoy snow activities at 3,000 meters elevation.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Return to Lucerne. Scenic one-hour cruise on Lake Lucerne with stunning Alpine backdrops. Free time for shopping Swiss watches and chocolates.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner at leisure. Explore Lucerne's evening atmosphere or enjoy a lakeside walk.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Interlaken Transfer & Adventure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Scenic train journey through the Brünig Pass to Interlaken, nestled between Lake Thun and Lake Brienz with views of the Jungfrau massif.

Afternoon (1:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Check into your hotel. Explore Interlaken's Höheweg promenade with mountain views. Optional adventure activities: paragliding, canyon jumping, or a boat cruise on Lake Brienz.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner overlooking the Jungfrau, Mönch, and Eiger peaks.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Jungfraujoch - Top of Europe
activities: Morning (7:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Early departure for the highlight excursion to Jungfraujoch, Europe's highest railway station at 3,454 meters. Ascend via cogwheel train through Kleine Scheidegg. Explore the Ice Palace, Sphinx Observatory, and Alpine Sensation exhibition.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Lunch at the Top of Europe restaurant with views of the Aletsch Glacier. Descend via Grindelwald, enjoying different mountain perspectives.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to Interlaken. Relaxing evening after the mountain adventure.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Zermatt & Matterhorn
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Scenic train journey to Zermatt, the car-free Alpine village at the foot of the Matterhorn. Check into your hotel and explore the charming village with its traditional wooden chalets.
Afternoon (1:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Ride the Gornergrat Bahn cogwheel railway to 3,089 meters for spectacular panoramic views of the Matterhorn, Monte Rosa, and 29 surrounding peaks.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner at a traditional Valais restaurant featuring raclette and local specialties.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Zermatt Exploration
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Optional excursion to the Matterhorn Glacier Paradise via cable car, reaching 3,883 meters—the highest cable car station in Europe. Visit the Glacier Palace and enjoy 360-degree Alpine views.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Zermatt's boutiques, the Matterhorn Museum, or take a leisurely hike through Alpine meadows with wildflowers (summer) or enjoy the village atmosphere.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner with final views of the Matterhorn at sunset.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Return to Zurich via Bern
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Scenic train journey back toward Zurich. Stop in Bern, Switzerland's charming capital. Guided tour of the UNESCO World Heritage Old Town with its medieval arcades, Zytglogge clock tower, and Bear Park.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue to Zurich. Check into your hotel. Explore Zurich's elegant Bahnhofstrasse shopping street and the charming old town.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner in Zurich celebrating your Swiss Alpine journey.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast. Optional visit to the Rhine Falls, Europe's largest waterfall, if time permits.
Afternoon (1:00 PM onwards): Transfer to Zurich Airport for departure.

packages.title: Swiss Lakes & Cities
packages.overview: Discover Switzerland's elegant cities and pristine lakes on this sophisticated journey through the country's most beautiful regions. Experience the cosmopolitan flair of Zurich, the international atmosphere of Geneva, and the Italian charm of Lugano. Cruise on crystal-clear lakes surrounded by mountains, explore medieval old towns, and savor Swiss and international cuisine. This tour perfectly balances urban culture with natural beauty, offering a refined Swiss experience that showcases the country's diversity, from German-speaking regions to French and Italian Switzerland.
highlights: Geneva's Jet d'Eau and international quarter

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zurich
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Arrive at Zurich Airport. Transfer to your elegant hotel in the city center.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Guided tour of Zurich. Explore the charming Altstadt (old town) with its medieval streets, visit the Fraumünster Church with Chagall windows, and stroll along the exclusive Bahnhofstrasse.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a restaurant overlooking Lake Zurich, featuring Swiss and international cuisine.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Zurich Culture & Rhine Falls
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit the Kunsthaus Zurich art museum or the Swiss National Museum. Cruise on Lake Zurich with views of the Alps.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Excursion to the Rhine Falls, Europe's largest waterfall. Take a boat ride to the rock in the middle of the falls for an exhilarating experience.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to Zurich. Evening in the trendy Zurich West district with its restaurants and nightlife.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Geneva Transfer & City Tour
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Scenic train journey to Geneva, Switzerland's French-speaking international city. Check into your hotel.

Afternoon (1:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Guided tour of Geneva. See the iconic Jet d'Eau fountain, explore the old town with St. Pierre Cathedral, visit the United Nations headquarters, and stroll through the English Garden with its famous flower clock.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner in Geneva's old town featuring Swiss-French cuisine.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Montreux & Chillon Castle
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Scenic train journey along Lake Geneva to Montreux, the elegant lakeside resort. Visit the stunning Chillon Castle, a medieval fortress on the lake that inspired Lord Byron.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Montreux's beautiful lakeside promenade lined with flowers and palm trees. Optional visit to Rochers-de-Naye by cogwheel train for panoramic views, or explore the Lavaux vineyard terraces (UNESCO World Heritage).
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to Geneva. Dinner at a lakeside restaurant.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Lugano & Italian Switzerland
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Scenic train journey through the Gotthard Tunnel to Lugano in Italian-speaking Ticino. Experience the Mediterranean atmosphere with palm trees and Italian architecture.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Check into your hotel. Explore Lugano's elegant lakeside promenade, the charming old town with its Italian piazzas, and the Cathedral of San Lorenzo.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner featuring Italian-Swiss cuisine with risotto, polenta, and local Merlot wine.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Lake Lugano & Villages
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Boat cruise on Lake Lugano to the picturesque fishing village of Gandria. Explore its narrow lanes and lakeside charm. Optional funicular ride to Monte Brè or Monte San Salvatore for panoramic views.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit the charming village of Morcote, considered one of Switzerland's most beautiful villages. Explore its Mediterranean-style architecture and lakeside setting.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner in Lugano celebrating your Swiss journey.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Return to Zurich & Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Scenic train journey back to Zurich through the Gotthard Panorama route.
Afternoon (2:00 PM onwards): Transfer to Zurich Airport for departure.

packages.title: Glacier Express & Scenic Railways
packages.overview: Embark on Switzerland's most legendary train journeys, experiencing the country's spectacular landscapes from the comfort of panoramic coaches. This railway adventure features the iconic Glacier Express, the Bernina Express, and other scenic routes that traverse mountain passes, cross viaducts, and wind through Alpine valleys. Witness Switzerland's engineering marvels while enjoying breathtaking views of glaciers, peaks, and pristine villages. This tour is perfect for travelers who want to experience Switzerland's beauty without strenuous hiking, combining comfort, scenery, and Swiss precision.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zurich & Lucerne
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Arrive at Zurich Airport. Train to Lucerne. Check into your hotel.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Lucerne's highlights: Chapel Bridge, old town, and lakefront.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner with views of Lake Lucerne and mountains.

itinerary.title: Day 2: GoldenPass Line to Interlaken & Zermatt
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Board the GoldenPass Line panoramic train from Lucerne to Interlaken. Enjoy stunning views of lakes, mountains, and valleys through large windows.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue by train to Zermatt, the car-free Alpine village. Check into your hotel with Matterhorn views.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Explore Zermatt's charming streets. Dinner featuring Valais specialties.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Gornergrat Railway & Zermatt
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Ride the Gornergrat Bahn cogwheel railway to 3,089 meters. Spectacular 360-degree views of the Matterhorn, Monte Rosa, and surrounding peaks.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Free time in Zermatt. Optional visit to the Matterhorn Museum or shopping for Swiss products.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Relaxing evening in Zermatt.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Glacier Express - The Slowest Express Train
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 4:00 PM): Board the legendary Glacier Express for one of the world's most scenic train journeys. Travel from Zermatt to St. Moritz (or Chur) through 91 tunnels and across 291 bridges. Cross the Oberalp Pass at 2,033 meters. Enjoy lunch served at your seat while admiring the spectacular Alpine scenery.
Afternoon (4:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Arrive in St. Moritz, Switzerland's most famous Alpine resort. Check into your luxury hotel.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Explore St. Moritz's elegant boutiques and lakeside promenade. Dinner at a gourmet restaurant.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Bernina Express to Tirano
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Board the Bernina Express, a UNESCO World Heritage railway. Journey through dramatic landscapes from St. Moritz to Tirano, Italy. Cross the Bernina Pass at 2,253 meters, traverse the spectacular Landwasser Viaduct, and descend through Alpine meadows to Mediterranean palm trees.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Tirano, Italy. Enjoy Italian lunch and atmosphere. Return journey to St. Moritz or continue to Chur.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner celebrating your railway adventure.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Return to Zurich & Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Scenic train journey back to Zurich through beautiful Swiss landscapes.
Afternoon (2:00 PM onwards): Transfer to Zurich Airport for departure.

packages.title: Swiss Winter Wonderland
packages.overview: Experience the magic of Switzerland in winter, where snow-covered peaks, world-class ski resorts, and cozy Alpine villages create a fairy-tale atmosphere. This winter adventure combines thrilling skiing and snowboarding with scenic mountain excursions, charming Christmas markets, and Swiss winter traditions. Whether you're an experienced skier or prefer snow activities like sledding and winter hiking, this package offers the perfect Alpine winter escape. Warm up with fondue and mulled wine after days spent in the pristine snow, and discover why Switzerland is the ultimate winter destination.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival & Interlaken
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Arrive at Zurich Airport. Scenic winter train journey to Interlaken. Check into your cozy Alpine hotel.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Interlaken's winter atmosphere. Visit local shops and enjoy views of snow-covered Jungfrau, Mönch, and Eiger peaks.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner featuring traditional Swiss fondue in a rustic mountain restaurant.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Jungfraujoch Winter Experience
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Excursion to Jungfraujoch in winter. Experience the snow-covered "Top of Europe" with its Ice Palace, snow activities, and breathtaking glacier views. The winter landscape is particularly magical.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Return to Interlaken. Optional winter activities: ice skating, winter hiking, or visiting a thermal spa.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Relaxing evening. Dinner at your hotel or local restaurant.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Transfer to Zermatt & Skiing
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Train journey to Zermatt. Check into your ski-in/ski-out hotel or luxury chalet.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Collect ski equipment and explore Zermatt's winter village. Ride the cable car for sunset views of the Matterhorn.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner at a mountain restaurant accessible by snowcat or cable car.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Skiing in Zermatt
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 4:00 PM): Full day skiing or snowboarding in Zermatt's extensive ski area with over 360km of slopes. Ski with views of the Matterhorn. Options for all levels from beginners to experts. Non-skiers can enjoy winter hiking, sledding, or spa treatments.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Après-ski in Zermatt's cozy bars. Dinner featuring raclette and Swiss wines.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Skiing & Winter Activities
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 4:00 PM): Another day of skiing or winter activities. Options include: skiing to Italy via the Theodul Pass, taking a helicopter tour, visiting the Matterhorn Glacier Paradise, or enjoying a winter hike through snowy forests.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner in Zermatt celebrating your winter adventure.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Lucerne & Christmas Markets
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Train journey to Lucerne. Check into your hotel.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Lucerne's winter charm. Visit Christmas markets (November-December) with handcrafted gifts, mulled wine, and festive atmosphere. Walk across the snow-dusted Chapel Bridge.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner in Lucerne's old town.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Departure

packages.title: Swiss Hiking & Nature
packages.overview: Discover Switzerland's pristine natural beauty on foot, hiking through Alpine meadows, alongside turquoise lakes, and beneath towering peaks. This active adventure is designed for nature lovers and hiking enthusiasts who want to experience Switzerland's legendary trails and breathtaking landscapes. From easy lakeside walks to more challenging mountain hikes, this tour offers diverse experiences combined with comfortable accommodations and Swiss hospitality. Breathe the fresh mountain air, spot Alpine wildlife, and discover why Switzerland is a hiker's paradise.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival & Interlaken
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Arrive at Zurich Airport. Train to Interlaken. Check into your hotel.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Easy orientation hike around Interlaken or along Lake Brienz. Prepare for the hiking adventure ahead.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner. Briefing about the week's hiking routes.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Oeschinen Lake Hike
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Cable car to Oeschinen Lake, a stunning Alpine lake surrounded by dramatic peaks. Hike around the lake with turquoise water and mountain reflections. Moderate difficulty, approximately 3-4 hours.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Return to Interlaken. Free time to relax or explore.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner at a traditional Swiss restaurant.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Grindelwald First Cliff Walk
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Cable car to Grindelwald First. Experience the First Cliff Walk suspension bridge with dramatic views. Hike to Bachalpsee, a beautiful mountain lake reflecting the surrounding peaks. Moderate hike, 2-3 hours.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Optional activities: First Flyer zipline, mountain cart, or additional hiking.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to Interlaken. Relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Transfer to Zermatt & Village Walk
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Scenic train journey to Zermatt. Check into your hotel.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Easy hike through Zermatt's surroundings with Matterhorn views. Explore traditional Valais villages and Alpine architecture.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner in Zermatt.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Five Lakes Walk
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 3:00 PM): Cable car to Blauherd. Hike the famous Five Lakes Walk (5-Seenweg), passing five pristine mountain lakes, each reflecting the Matterhorn from different angles. Moderate hike, approximately 4-5 hours with spectacular photo opportunities.
Afternoon (3:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Return to Zermatt. Free time to explore or relax.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner at a mountain restaurant.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Aletsch Glacier Hike
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 3:00 PM): Train and cable car to the Aletsch Arena. Hike along the Aletsch Glacier, the largest glacier in the Alps and a UNESCO World Heritage site. Witness the dramatic ice formations and Alpine landscape. Moderate difficulty.
Afternoon (3:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Return journey to Zermatt or transfer to Lucerne area.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner celebrating your hiking achievements.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast. Transfer to Zurich Airport.
Afternoon (1:00 PM onwards): Departure.

name: SPAIN
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

Spain dazzles with its passionate culture, diverse landscapes, and rich history spanning Roman ruins to Moorish palaces and Gothic cathedrals. From the artistic treasures of Madrid and Barcelona's Gaudí masterpieces to the sun-drenched beaches of the Costa del Sol and the flamenco rhythms of Andalusia, Spain offers an intoxicating blend of experiences. Savor world-renowned cuisine from tapas to paella, explore medieval towns and modern cities, and immerse yourself in the Spanish zest for life. Whether wandering through the Alhambra's intricate halls, cheering at a football match, or enjoying late-night dinners, Spain captivates with its warmth, creativity, and vibrant spirit.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Madrid  
**Currency:** Euro (EUR)  
**Time Zone:** Central European Time (CET, UTC+1)  
**Driving Side:** Right  
**Calling Code:** +34  
**Best Season to Visit:** April to June, September to October  
**Languages Spoken:** Spanish (Castilian), Catalan, Basque, Galician, English (in tourist areas)

### Essential Travel Tips

**ATM & Banking:** ATMs are widely available throughout Spain. Most accept international cards. Notify your bank before traveling.

**Credit Cards:** Visa and Mastercard are widely accepted in cities and tourist areas. Smaller establishments may prefer cash. Contactless payment is common.

**Transportation:** Spain has excellent high-speed trains (AVE) connecting major cities. Metro systems in Madrid and Barcelona are efficient. Buses serve most destinations. Car rentals are ideal for exploring rural areas and coastal routes.

**Safety:** Spain is generally safe for tourists. Watch for pickpockets in Barcelona, Madrid, and tourist areas. Keep valuables secure, especially on public transport and in crowded places.

**Shopping:** Spain offers fashion, leather goods, ceramics, wine, olive oil, and artisan crafts. Markets are excellent for local products. Shops typically close for siesta (2-5 PM) and reopen in the evening.

**Cuisine:** Spanish cuisine is diverse and delicious. Don't miss tapas, paella, jamón ibérico, churros, and regional specialties. Dinner is typically late (9-11 PM). Tipping is appreciated but not mandatory.

**Public Transport:** Metro systems in major cities are efficient and affordable. Purchase multi-day passes for savings. Validate tickets before boarding buses and trains.

**Weather:** Summers are hot, especially inland and in the south. Spring and fall offer pleasant temperatures. Coastal areas have milder climates. Winter is mild in the south, cooler in the north.

### Tourism Summary

Spain ranks among the world's top tourist destinations, attracting visitors with its incredible diversity and cultural richness. Travelers flock to Barcelona's Sagrada Família and Park Güell, Madrid's Prado Museum and Royal Palace, Seville's flamenco shows and Moorish architecture, and Granada's magnificent Alhambra. The country's regions offer distinct experiences—from Basque Country's culinary excellence to Andalusia's white villages, Catalonia's Costa Brava to the Balearic Islands' beaches. Spain's combination of historical treasures, artistic masterpieces, culinary delights, vibrant nightlife, and warm hospitality creates an unforgettable Mediterranean experience that keeps visitors returning year after year.

---

## SPAIN TOUR PACKAGES

packages.title: Barcelona & Gaudí Masterpieces
packages.overview: Immerse yourself in Barcelona's unique blend of Gothic charm and modernist innovation. This captivating journey explores Antoni Gaudí's architectural masterpieces, from the awe-inspiring Sagrada Família to the whimsical Park Güell. Wander through the medieval Gothic Quarter, stroll along Las Ramblas, and savor Catalan cuisine in bustling markets and tapas bars. Experience Barcelona's vibrant culture, Mediterranean beaches, and artistic soul. This perfectly paced tour captures the essence of Catalonia's cosmopolitan capital, where creativity and tradition merge in spectacular fashion.
highlights: La Boqueria market and tapas tour

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Barcelona
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Arrive at Barcelona Airport. Transfer to your centrally located hotel near Passeig de Gràcia.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Orientation walking tour of the Gothic Quarter (Barri Gòtic). Explore narrow medieval streets, visit the Barcelona Cathedral, and discover hidden plazas. Walk along Las Ramblas to the waterfront.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a traditional Catalan restaurant featuring pa amb tomàquet, escalivada, and crema catalana.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Gaudí's Masterpieces
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Skip-the-line entry to the Sagrada Família, Gaudí's unfinished masterpiece. Guided tour of the basilica's stunning interior with its forest-like columns and colorful stained glass. Climb one of the towers for city views.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit Casa Batlló with its dragon-inspired facade and organic interior design. Continue to Casa Milà (La Pedrera) with its undulating stone facade and rooftop chimneys. Explore the Gaudí exhibition.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Free evening. Optional flamenco show or explore the trendy El Born neighborhood.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Park Güell & Montjuïc
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit Park Güell, Gaudí's colorful mosaic wonderland with its serpentine bench, gingerbread houses, and panoramic city views. Explore the whimsical architecture and gardens.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Cable car to Montjuïc hill. Visit the Olympic Stadium, Montjuïc Castle with harbor views, and the Joan Miró Foundation. Explore the beautiful gardens.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Watch the Magic Fountain show with its choreographed water, light, and music display. Dinner in the Poble Sec neighborhood.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Markets & Beach
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Guided food tour through La Boqueria market on Las Ramblas. Taste fresh fruits, jamón, cheeses, and seafood. Continue with a tapas crawl through the Gothic Quarter, sampling patatas bravas, croquetas, and local wines.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Relax on Barceloneta Beach. Stroll along the palm-lined promenade, enjoy the Mediterranean atmosphere, or take a dip in the sea.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner at a beachfront restaurant featuring paella and sangria.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast. Last-minute shopping on Passeig de Gràcia or visit to the Picasso Museum if time permits.
Afternoon (1:00 PM onwards): Transfer to Barcelona Airport for departure.

packages.title: Madrid & Toledo Heritage
packages.overview: Discover Spain's regal capital and its rich artistic and historical heritage. This cultural journey takes you through Madrid's world-class museums, grand boulevards, and vibrant neighborhoods, combined with a day trip to the medieval city of Toledo. Experience the masterpieces of Prado Museum, the grandeur of the Royal Palace, and the energy of Madrid's tapas scene. Explore Toledo's labyrinthine streets where Christian, Jewish, and Muslim cultures intertwined for centuries. This tour perfectly captures the essence of Spanish history, art, and contemporary urban life.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Madrid
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Arrive at Madrid Airport. Transfer to your elegant hotel near Gran Vía or Puerta del Sol.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Orientation walking tour of Madrid's historic center. Explore Plaza Mayor, Puerta del Sol, and the charming streets of the Austrias neighborhood. Visit the stunning Almudena Cathedral.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a traditional Madrid restaurant featuring cocido madrileño and local wines.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Art & Royalty
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Skip-the-line entry to the Prado Museum, one of the world's finest art galleries. Guided tour of masterpieces by Velázquez, Goya, El Greco, and other Spanish masters.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit the magnificent Royal Palace with its opulent rooms, throne hall, and royal armory. Stroll through the adjacent Sabatini Gardens.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Tapas tour through the La Latina neighborhood. Sample traditional tapas at historic taverns while learning about Madrid's culinary culture.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Toledo Day Trip
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Full-day excursion to Toledo, the "City of Three Cultures." Guided tour of this UNESCO World Heritage medieval city. Visit the stunning Toledo Cathedral, the Alcázar fortress, and the Church of Santo Tomé housing El Greco's masterpiece.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Toledo's narrow streets, Jewish Quarter, and artisan workshops famous for damascene metalwork. Enjoy panoramic views of the city surrounded by the Tagus River.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Return to Madrid. Authentic flamenco show with dinner, experiencing the passion and artistry of Spain's iconic dance.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Parks & Modern Madrid
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Explore Retiro Park, Madrid's green lung. Row a boat on the lake, visit the Crystal Palace, and stroll through the rose gardens. Walk along the elegant Paseo del Prado.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit the Reina Sofía Museum to see Picasso's Guernica and modern Spanish art. Explore the trendy Malasaña or Chueca neighborhoods with their boutiques and cafés.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Farewell dinner at a rooftop restaurant with views of Madrid's skyline.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast. Last-minute shopping on Gran Vía or visit to the Mercado de San Miguel.
Afternoon (1:00 PM onwards): Transfer to Madrid Airport for departure.

packages.title: Andalusia Discovery
packages.overview: Journey through the soul of southern Spain, where Moorish palaces, white villages, and flamenco rhythms create an unforgettable experience. This comprehensive Andalusian adventure explores the region's three jewels—Seville, Granada, and Córdoba—along with the stunning white villages and coastal beauty. Discover the Alhambra's intricate beauty, experience authentic flamenco in its birthplace, and savor the flavors of Andalusian cuisine. From the Mezquita's horseshoe arches to the dramatic gorge of Ronda, this tour captures the essence of Spain's most romantic and historically rich region.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Málaga & Ronda
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Arrive at Málaga Airport. Scenic drive through Andalusian countryside to Ronda.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Ronda, dramatically perched on a gorge. Visit the iconic Puente Nuevo bridge spanning the 120-meter chasm, the historic bullring, and enjoy breathtaking views.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Check into your hotel. Welcome dinner featuring Andalusian specialties.

itinerary.title: Day 2: White Villages & Seville
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Drive through the Route of White Villages (Pueblos Blancos). Stop in charming villages like Zahara de la Sierra or Grazalema with their whitewashed houses and mountain settings.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue to Seville, Andalusia's vibrant capital. Check into your hotel in the historic center.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Evening stroll through the Santa Cruz neighborhood. Dinner at a traditional tapas bar.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Seville Highlights
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Guided tour of Seville Cathedral, the world's largest Gothic cathedral, and climb the Giralda tower for city views. Visit the Royal Alcázar with its stunning Mudéjar architecture and lush gardens.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore the charming Santa Cruz quarter with its narrow streets and flower-filled patios. Visit Plaza de España with its colorful ceramic tiles. Stroll along the Guadalquivir River.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Authentic flamenco show in the Triana neighborhood, the birthplace of flamenco. Dinner featuring Andalusian cuisine.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Córdoba Excursion
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Day trip to Córdoba. Visit the magnificent Mezquita, the Great Mosque-Cathedral with its forest of columns and horseshoe arches—a masterpiece of Islamic architecture.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Córdoba's Jewish Quarter with its narrow streets, the Synagogue, and the Alcázar de los Reyes Cristianos with its beautiful gardens.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to Seville. Free evening to explore or relax.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Granada Transfer & Albaicín
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Scenic drive to Granada. Check into your hotel with views of the Alhambra.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore the Albaicín, Granada's historic Moorish quarter. Wander through narrow cobblestone streets to the Mirador de San Nicolás for the iconic view of the Alhambra with the Sierra Nevada behind it.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner in the Albaicín. Experience Granada's tradition of free tapas with drinks.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Alhambra & Generalife
activities: Morning (8:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Skip-the-line guided tour of the Alhambra, Spain's most visited monument. Explore the Nasrid Palaces with their intricate Islamic art, the Alcazaba fortress, and the stunning Generalife gardens with fountains and flowers.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit the Royal Chapel where Catholic Monarchs are buried, and Granada Cathedral. Free time for shopping or relaxing.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner with views of the illuminated Alhambra.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Sierra Nevada or Coast
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 6:00 PM): Optional day trip to the Sierra Nevada mountains for hiking and village exploration, or to the Costa Tropical for beach relaxation. Alternatively, enjoy a leisurely day in Granada.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Final evening in Granada.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Transfer to Málaga or Granada Airport for departure.

packages.title: Costa del Sol Beach & Culture
packages.overview: Experience the perfect blend of Mediterranean beaches, Andalusian culture, and coastal charm on Spain's famous Sun Coast. This relaxing yet culturally rich journey combines beach relaxation with exploration of charming coastal towns, historic sites, and vibrant nightlife. From Marbella's glamorous marina to Nerja's dramatic caves and Málaga's artistic heritage, discover why the Costa del Sol has been a beloved destination for decades. Enjoy fresh seafood, water sports, and the laid-back Mediterranean lifestyle under the Spanish sun.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Málaga
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Arrive at Málaga Airport. Transfer to your beachfront hotel on the Costa del Sol.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Relax on the beach or by the pool. Settle into the Mediterranean rhythm.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a beachfront chiringuito (beach restaurant) featuring fresh seafood and sangria.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Málaga City Tour
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Guided tour of Málaga, Picasso's birthplace. Visit the Picasso Museum, the Moorish Alcazaba fortress with harbor views, and the Roman Theatre.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Málaga's historic center, the Cathedral, and the vibrant Atarazanas Market. Stroll along the palm-lined Muelle Uno waterfront.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to your hotel. Dinner at leisure.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Marbella & Puerto Banús
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit Marbella's charming old town with its whitewashed streets, orange trees, and Plaza de los Naranjos. Explore boutiques and cafés.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Puerto Banús, the glamorous marina filled with luxury yachts, designer boutiques, and upscale restaurants. People-watch from a waterfront café.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Sunset at a beach club. Dinner in Puerto Banús or return to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Nerja & Frigiliana
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit the spectacular Nerja Caves with their impressive stalactites and stalagmites. Explore Nerja town and the famous Balcón de Europa viewpoint overlooking the Mediterranean.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Drive to Frigiliana, one of Spain's most beautiful white villages. Wander through narrow streets with flower-filled balconies and stunning mountain views.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to your hotel. Relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Beach Day & Catamaran Cruise
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Free morning for beach activities: swimming, paddleboarding, jet skiing, or simply relaxing on the sand.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Sunset catamaran cruise along the Costa del Sol. Swim in secluded coves, enjoy drinks on deck, and watch the sun set over the Mediterranean.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner at a Michelin-recommended restaurant featuring modern Andalusian cuisine.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast with sea views. Last swim or beach walk.
Afternoon (1:00 PM onwards): Transfer to Málaga Airport for departure.

packages.title: Basque Country Culinary Journey
packages.overview: Discover Spain's gastronomic capital and the unique Basque culture that blends Spanish and French influences. This culinary-focused journey takes you through San Sebastián's Michelin-starred restaurants and pintxos bars, Bilbao's Guggenheim Museum and traditional taverns, and the charming coastal villages of the Basque Country. Experience world-class cuisine, stunning coastal scenery, and a distinct cultural identity. From innovative molecular gastronomy to traditional cider houses, this tour is a paradise for food lovers and culture enthusiasts.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Bilbao
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Arrive at Bilbao Airport. Transfer to your hotel in the city center.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Guided tour of the iconic Guggenheim Museum with its titanium curves and contemporary art collection. Stroll along the Nervión River and explore the modern city.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a traditional Basque restaurant featuring bacalao al pil-pil and txakoli wine.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Bilbao Old Town & Transfer to San Sebastián
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Explore Bilbao's Casco Viejo (old town) with its seven streets, the stunning Santiago Cathedral, and the bustling Ribera Market. Sample pintxos at traditional bars.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Scenic drive to San Sebastián. Check into your elegant hotel near La Concha beach.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Pintxos bar hopping tour through the Parte Vieja (old town). Sample creative pintxos paired with local wines at renowned bars.

itinerary.title: Day 3: San Sebastián Highlights
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Walk along La Concha beach, one of Europe's most beautiful urban beaches. Take the funicular to Monte Igueldo for panoramic views of the bay.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit the Aquarium and explore the old town's charming streets. Free time for shopping or beach relaxation.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Optional Michelin-starred dining experience at one of San Sebastián's renowned restaurants, or continue exploring pintxos bars.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Coastal Villages
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit Getaria, a charming fishing village. Tour a txakoli winery and taste the local sparkling white wine. Visit the Balenciaga Museum dedicated to the famous fashion designer.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Continue to Hondarribia, a beautiful fortified town on the French border. Explore its medieval streets, colorful houses, and harbor.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to San Sebastián. Dinner at leisure.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Cider House Experience
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Free morning to enjoy La Concha beach, visit the San Telmo Museum, or explore the Gros neighborhood.

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit a traditional Basque cider house (sidrería). Experience the ritual of catching cider directly from the barrel and enjoy a traditional multi-course cider house menu.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Return to San Sebastián. Farewell evening exploring the city.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Departure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Final breakfast. Transfer to Bilbao or San Sebastián Airport for departure.

name: UNITED KINGDOM
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

The United Kingdom captivates with its rich tapestry of history, royal heritage, and cultural diversity spanning England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. From London's iconic landmarks and world-class museums to Scotland's dramatic Highlands, Wales' medieval castles, and Ireland's stunning coastlines, the UK offers endless discoveries. Experience the pomp of Buckingham Palace, the mystery of Stonehenge, the literary charm of Oxford and Edinburgh, and the vibrant energy of contemporary British culture. Whether exploring ancient Roman ruins, enjoying afternoon tea, or hiking through breathtaking landscapes, the UK seamlessly blends centuries of tradition with modern innovation.

### Country Information

**Capital:** London  
**Currency:** British Pound Sterling (GBP)  
**Time Zone:** Greenwich Mean Time (GMT, UTC+0)  
**Driving Side:** Left  
**Calling Code:** +44  
**Best Season to Visit:** May to September  
**Languages Spoken:** English, Welsh, Scottish Gaelic, Irish

### Essential Travel Tips

**ATM & Banking:** ATMs widely available. Most accept international cards. Contactless payment is extremely common.

**Credit Cards:** Visa and Mastercard widely accepted. Chip-and-PIN standard. Contactless payment up to £100.

**Transportation:** Excellent public transport. London Underground (Tube) is extensive. Trains connect major cities efficiently. Oyster cards or contactless payment for London transport. Driving on the left side.

**Safety:** UK is generally very safe. Watch for pickpockets in tourist areas. Emergency number: 999.

**Shopping:** UK offers fashion, antiques, books, tea, whisky, and crafts. High streets and markets throughout. VAT refunds available for tourists.

**Cuisine:** Traditional British food includes fish and chips, Sunday roast, afternoon tea, and full English breakfast. Diverse international cuisine in cities. Tipping 10-15% in restaurants.

**Public Transport:** Extensive train and bus networks. Book trains in advance for best prices. London transport requires Oyster card or contactless payment.

**Weather:** Unpredictable and often rainy. Bring layers and waterproof jacket year-round. Summers mild, winters cool but rarely extreme.

### Tourism Summary

The United Kingdom stands as one of the world's most visited destinations, drawing travelers with its royal palaces, historic universities, literary heritage, and stunning natural landscapes. Visitors explore London's Big Ben, Tower of London, and British Museum, discover Edinburgh's castle and festivals, tour Oxford and Cambridge's ancient colleges, and marvel at Stonehenge's prehistoric mystery. The Lake District's mountains, Scottish Highlands' wilderness, Cotswolds' villages, and Cornwall's beaches offer natural beauty. The UK's influence on literature, music, art, and democracy creates a profound cultural experience that resonates with visitors from around the globe.

### Country Overview

Greece enchants travelers with its ancient ruins, sun-drenched islands, and azure Mediterranean waters. This cradle of Western civilization offers an intoxicating blend of archaeological wonders, Byzantine churches, whitewashed villages, and vibrant modern culture. From the Acropolis' timeless majesty to Santorini's romantic sunsets, Mykonos' cosmopolitan energy, and Crete's diverse landscapes, Greece delivers beauty and history at every turn. Savor fresh Mediterranean cuisine, explore mythological sites, relax on pristine beaches, and experience the legendary Greek hospitality that has welcomed travelers for millennia.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Athens  
**Currency:** Euro (EUR)  
**Time Zone:** Eastern European Time (EET, UTC+2)  
**Driving Side:** Right  
**Calling Code:** +30  
**Best Season to Visit:** April to June, September to October  
**Languages Spoken:** Greek, English (widely spoken in tourist areas)

### Essential Travel Tips

**ATM & Banking:** ATMs widely available in cities and tourist areas. May be limited on smaller islands. Notify bank before travel.

**Credit Cards:** Visa and Mastercard accepted in most hotels and restaurants. Smaller establishments and islands may prefer cash.

**Transportation:** Excellent ferry connections between islands. Domestic flights available. Metro in Athens is efficient. Car rentals useful for exploring mainland and larger islands.

**Safety:** Greece is very safe for tourists. Watch for pickpockets in crowded tourist areas in Athens. Be cautious on mopeds/ATVs on islands.

**Shopping:** Greece offers olive oil, honey, wine, ceramics, jewelry, and leather goods. Markets and local shops offer authentic products.

**Cuisine:** Greek cuisine is fresh and delicious. Don't miss moussaka, souvlaki, Greek salad, tzatziki, fresh seafood, and baklava. Tipping 5-10% appreciated.

**Public Transport:** Athens metro is modern and efficient. Buses connect most areas. Island ferries can be delayed by weather. Book in advance during peak season.

**Weather:** Summers are hot and dry, especially July-August. Spring and fall offer pleasant temperatures. Winter is mild but some islands have limited services.

### Tourism Summary

Greece stands as one of the Mediterranean's most beloved destinations, attracting visitors with its unparalleled combination of ancient history, island beauty, and cultural richness. Travelers explore Athens' Acropolis and Parthenon, island-hop through the Cyclades' whitewashed villages, discover Crete's Minoan palaces, and relax on countless pristine beaches. Santorini's caldera views, Mykonos' vibrant nightlife, Rhodes' medieval old town, and Delphi's ancient oracle site showcase Greece's diversity. The country's warm hospitality, delicious cuisine, and the magical quality of Aegean light create an experience that captures hearts and inspires return visits.

---

packages.title: Athens & Ancient Wonders

This journey combines ancient history with contemporary Greek culture, from the Acropolis' sacred rock to vibrant neighborhoods filled with tavernas and street art. Experience the energy of modern Athens while connecting with 2,500 years of history that shaped the world.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Athens
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Arrive at Athens Airport. Transfer to your hotel with Acropolis views.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Orientation walking tour of Plaka, Athens' oldest neighborhood. Explore narrow streets, neoclassical buildings, and local shops beneath the Acropolis.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a traditional taverna featuring moussaka, souvlaki, and Greek wine with live bouzouki music.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Acropolis & Ancient Athens

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit the stunning Acropolis Museum with its glass floors revealing archaeological excavations. See the Parthenon marbles and ancient sculptures.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Explore Monastiraki Square and flea market. Dinner with Acropolis views.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Ancient Sites & Museums

Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Free evening in trendy Psiri or Gazi neighborhoods.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Cape Sounion

Evening (8:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Seafood dinner at a coastal taverna. Return to Athens.

packages.title: Santorini & Mykonos Island Paradise
packages.overview: Experience the magic of Greece's most iconic islands on this enchanting Cycladic journey. Santorini's dramatic caldera, whitewashed villages clinging to cliffs, and legendary sunsets create an unforgettable romantic atmosphere. Mykonos offers cosmopolitan energy with its charming windmills, pristine beaches, and vibrant nightlife. This perfect island combination balances relaxation with exploration, traditional charm with modern luxury, and natural beauty with cultural experiences. Cruise between islands, savor fresh seafood, and discover why these islands captivate travelers worldwide.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Santorini
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Arrive at Santorini Airport or ferry port. Transfer to your luxury cave hotel in Oia or Fira with caldera views.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore your hotel's infinity pool overlooking the caldera. Settle into island life.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Welcome dinner at a cliffside restaurant with sunset views. Sample Greek mezze and local Assyrtiko wine.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Santorini Exploration
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit the archaeological site of Akrotiri, an ancient Minoan city preserved by volcanic ash. Explore Red Beach with its dramatic red cliffs.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Wine tasting tour at traditional wineries. Sample volcanic wines while learning about unique viticulture. Visit Pyrgos village with its Venetian castle.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Watch the famous Santorini sunset from Oia's castle ruins. Dinner in Oia's charming streets.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Santorini Catamaran Cruise
activities: Morning (10:00 AM - 5:00 PM): Full-day catamaran cruise around Santorini. Sail past the caldera, swim in hot springs, snorkel in crystal-clear waters, and enjoy a BBQ lunch on board.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Relaxing evening at your hotel or explore Fira's nightlife.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Ferry to Mykonos
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Ferry from Santorini to Mykonos (approximately 2-3 hours). Arrive and check into your boutique hotel.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Mykonos Town (Chora). Visit the iconic windmills, Little Venice with its colorful balconies over the sea, and Paraportiani Church.
Evening (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM): Dinner in Mykonos Town. Experience the island's vibrant atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Mykonos Beaches
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit Delos Island, one of Greece's most important archaeological sites and Apollo's birthplace (optional excursion).
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 7:00 PM): Beach day at Paradise Beach, Super Paradise, or Psarou Beach. Enjoy beach clubs, water sports, or simply relax on golden sand.
Evening (7:00 PM - late): Sunset cocktails at a beach bar. Dinner and optional nightlife experience—Mykonos is famous for its party scene.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Mykonos Leisure
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Visit quieter beaches like Agios Sostis or Fokos. Explore traditional villages like Ano Mera with its monastery.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Shopping in Mykonos Town's boutiques. Relax at your hotel pool.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Farewell dinner at a seaside taverna featuring fresh seafood and Greek specialties.

packages.title: Crete Cultural & Beach Discovery
packages.overview: Explore Greece's largest and most diverse island, where ancient Minoan civilization meets stunning beaches, dramatic gorges, and charming villages. This comprehensive Cretan journey combines archaeological wonders, natural beauty, and authentic local culture. Discover the Palace of Knossos, hike the Samaria Gorge, relax on pink sand beaches, and savor Cretan cuisine renowned as one of the world's healthiest. From Heraklion's museums to Chania's Venetian harbor, experience the island that offers everything from history to adventure to relaxation.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Heraklion
activities: Morning (11:00 AM - 2:00 PM): Arrive at Heraklion Airport. Transfer to your hotel.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore Heraklion's historic center. Visit the Venetian fortress Koules and walk along the harbor. Explore the bustling market streets.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Welcome dinner featuring Cretan specialties like dakos, kalitsounia, and lamb with stamnagathi.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Knossos & Archaeological Museum
activities: Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM): Guided tour of the Palace of Knossos, Europe's oldest city and center of Minoan civilization. Explore the throne room, frescoes, and learn about the Minotaur legend.
Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Visit the Heraklion Archaeological Museum, one of Greece's finest, housing Minoan artifacts including the famous Snake Goddess figurines and Phaistos Disc.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner in Heraklion. Stroll through Lions Square.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Rethymno

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Relax on Rethymno's long sandy beach. Explore the narrow streets filled with shops and tavernas.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner at a waterfront taverna. Overnight in Rethymno or continue to Chania.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Chania

Afternoon (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Explore the leather street, covered market, and charming neighborhoods. Visit nearby Akrotiri Peninsula beaches.
Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM): Dinner at a harbor-side restaurant. Check into your Chania hotel.

name: GERMANY
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

Germany captivates with its fascinating blend of medieval charm and modern innovation, from fairy-tale castles to cutting-edge cities. This diverse nation offers the romantic Rhine Valley, Bavaria's Alpine beauty, Berlin's dynamic culture, and charming towns that seem frozen in time. Experience Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas markets, world-class museums, and precision engineering. From the Black Forest's dense woods to the Baltic coast's beaches, Gothic cathedrals to contemporary architecture, Germany delivers rich history, cultural depth, and efficient hospitality that makes exploration effortless and rewarding.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Berlin  
**Currency:** Euro (EUR)  
**Time Zone:** Central European Time (CET, UTC+1)  
**Driving Side:** Right  
**Calling Code:** +49  
**Best Season to Visit:** May to September, December (Christmas markets)  
**Languages Spoken:** German, English (widely spoken in cities)

### Essential Travel Tips

**ATM & Banking:** ATMs widely available. Germany still uses cash more than other European countries. Carry euros for smaller establishments.

**Credit Cards:** Credit cards accepted in most hotels and larger restaurants, but cash preferred in many places. Contactless payment growing.

**Transportation:** Excellent train network (Deutsche Bahn). Autobahn highways have no speed limits in sections. Public transport efficient in cities. Consider German Rail Pass.

**Safety:** Germany is very safe. Watch for pickpockets in tourist areas and train stations. Emergency number: 112.

**Shopping:** Germany offers beer steins, cuckoo clocks, Christmas decorations, porcelain, and quality goods. Shops closed Sundays except in train stations.

**Cuisine:** German food is hearty. Try bratwurst, schnitzel, pretzels, sauerkraut, and Black Forest cake. Beer culture is strong. Tipping 5-10% by rounding up.

**Public Transport:** Efficient metros, trams, and buses. Purchase tickets before boarding and validate them. Day passes offer good value.

**Weather:** Summers warm, winters cold with snow in south. Spring and fall pleasant. Weather can be unpredictable—bring layers.

### Tourism Summary

Germany attracts visitors with its remarkable diversity—from Berlin's vibrant arts scene and Munich's beer gardens to the Rhine Valley's castle-dotted landscapes and the Romantic Road's medieval towns. Travelers explore Neuschwanstein's fairy-tale castle, walk along the Berlin Wall remnants, experience Oktoberfest's festivities, and wander through Rothenburg's perfectly preserved medieval streets. The Black Forest, Bavarian Alps, and Rhine River offer natural beauty, while cities like Hamburg, Cologne, and Dresden showcase architectural splendor. Germany's efficient infrastructure, rich cultural heritage, and warm hospitality create an experience that balances history with modernity.

---

### Country Overview

The Netherlands charms with its iconic windmills, tulip fields, canal-lined cities, and rich artistic heritage. This compact nation offers Amsterdam's world-class museums and vibrant culture, charming villages with traditional architecture, and innovative modern design. Experience cycling through flat countryside, cruising picturesque canals, and exploring Golden Age masterpieces. From cheese markets to flower auctions, historic harbors to contemporary architecture, the Netherlands combines tradition with progressive thinking, creating a uniquely Dutch experience of beauty, tolerance, and quality of life.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Amsterdam  
**Currency:** Euro (EUR)  
**Time Zone:** Central European Time (CET, UTC+1)  
**Driving Side:** Right  
**Calling Code:** +31  
**Best Season to Visit:** April-May (tulips), June-August  
**Languages Spoken:** Dutch, English (very widely spoken)

### Essential Travel Tips

**ATM & Banking:** ATMs widely available. Cards accepted almost everywhere. Contactless payment very common.

**Credit Cards:** Debit cards preferred over credit cards. Many places don't accept credit cards. Maestro widely used.

**Transportation:** Excellent train network. Cycling is the primary mode of transport—bike rentals everywhere. Trams and buses efficient in cities.

**Safety:** Very safe country. Watch for pickpockets in Amsterdam tourist areas. Be careful of bicycles—they have right of way.

**Shopping:** Netherlands offers cheese, Delftware, tulip bulbs, clogs, and Dutch design. Shops may close Sundays and Mondays.

**Cuisine:** Try stroopwafels, bitterballen, herring, poffertjes, and Dutch pancakes. Indonesian food is popular. Tipping 5-10% appreciated.

**Public Transport:** OV-chipkaart for all public transport. Trains frequent and punctual. Cycling is easiest in cities.

**Weather:** Mild but rainy year-round. Bring waterproof jacket. Summers pleasant, winters cool. Wind can be strong.

### Tourism Summary

The Netherlands attracts visitors with its artistic treasures, charming canals, and distinctive culture. Travelers explore Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum, cruise the UNESCO canal ring, visit Anne Frank House, and photograph windmills at Kinderdijk. Spring's tulip fields create spectacular color displays, while historic cities like Delft, Haarlem, and Utrecht offer authentic Dutch charm. The country's flat landscape perfect for cycling, innovative architecture, and liberal atmosphere create a welcoming destination that balances rich history with contemporary creativity.

---

## NETHERLANDS TOUR PACKAGES

name: PORTUGAL
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

Portugal enchants with its dramatic Atlantic coastline, historic cities, and warm hospitality. This sun-blessed nation offers Lisbon's hilltop views and vintage trams, Porto's port wine cellars and riverside charm, the Algarve's golden beaches, and medieval towns filled with azulejo tiles. Experience fado music's soulful melodies, savor fresh seafood and pastéis de nata, and explore castles and monasteries that tell centuries of maritime history. From Sintra's romantic palaces to the Douro Valley's terraced vineyards, Portugal delivers beauty, culture, and authentic experiences at every turn.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Lisbon  
**Currency:** Euro (EUR)  
**Time Zone:** Western European Time (WET, UTC+0)  
**Driving Side:** Right  
**Calling Code:** +351  
**Best Season to Visit:** April to October  
**Languages Spoken:** Portuguese, English (in tourist areas)

### Essential Travel Tips

**ATM & Banking:** ATMs widely available. Cards accepted in most places. Notify bank before travel.

**Credit Cards:** Visa and Mastercard widely accepted. Smaller establishments may prefer cash.

**Transportation:** Good train and bus networks. Lisbon and Porto have efficient metros and trams. Car rental ideal for exploring countryside and Algarve.

**Safety:** Very safe country. Watch for pickpockets in Lisbon tourist areas and on trams. Be cautious on steep cobblestone streets.

**Shopping:** Portugal offers port wine, cork products, ceramics, azulejo tiles, and textiles. Markets offer local crafts.

**Cuisine:** Portuguese food is delicious and affordable. Try bacalhau (cod), grilled sardines, pastéis de nata, and seafood rice. Tipping 5-10% appreciated.

**Public Transport:** Lisbon's trams are iconic. Purchase rechargeable cards for public transport. Trains connect major cities efficiently.

**Weather:** Mild Mediterranean climate. Summers hot and dry, especially inland. Spring and fall pleasant. Winter mild with some rain.

### Tourism Summary

Portugal attracts visitors with its authentic charm, stunning coastlines, and rich cultural heritage. Travelers explore Lisbon's seven hills and Belém Tower, Porto's Ribeira district and port wine lodges, Sintra's fairy-tale palaces, and the Algarve's dramatic cliffs and beaches. The Douro Valley's terraced vineyards, medieval Óbidos' walls, and Évora's Roman temple showcase Portugal's diversity. The country's affordable prices, delicious cuisine, fado music, and genuine hospitality create a welcoming atmosphere. Portugal's blend of history, natural beauty, and laid-back lifestyle makes it one of Europe's most rewarding destinations.

---

name: JORDAN
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

Jordan captivates with its ancient wonders, dramatic desert landscapes, and warm Bedouin hospitality. From Petra's rose-red city carved into cliffs to Wadi Rum's Mars-like terrain, the Dead Sea's healing waters to Amman's modern vibrancy, Jordan offers biblical history and natural beauty. Experience authentic Middle Eastern culture, explore Roman ruins, and discover why Jordan is the perfect introduction to the Arab world—safe, welcoming, and endlessly fascinating.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Amman  
**Currency:** Jordanian Dinar (JOD)  
**Time Zone:** EET (UTC+2)  
**Driving Side:** Right  
**Calling Code:** +962  
**Best Season:** March-May, September-November  
**Languages:** Arabic, English widely spoken

### Essential Travel Tips

**ATM & Banking:** ATMs available in cities. US dollars widely accepted. Exchange at banks for best rates.

**Credit Cards:** Accepted in hotels and larger establishments. Cash needed for smaller shops and markets.

**Transportation:** Taxis and private drivers common. JETT buses connect major sites. Renting a car possible but challenging.

**Safety:** Very safe for tourists. Jordanians are welcoming. Dress modestly, especially at religious sites.

**Shopping:** Jordan offers Dead Sea products, handicrafts, jewelry, and spices. Bargaining expected in souks.

**Cuisine:** Try mansaf (national dish), falafel, hummus, and kunafa. Mint tea ubiquitous. Tipping 10% appreciated.

**Public Transport:** Limited. Most tourists use private drivers or organized tours for efficiency.

**Weather:** Hot, dry summers. Pleasant spring and fall. Winter can be cold, especially in Petra. Bring sun protection.

### Tourism Summary

Jordan attracts visitors with Petra's archaeological wonder, one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, Wadi Rum's otherworldly desert landscapes, and the Dead Sea's unique floating experience. Travelers explore Jerash's Roman ruins, Amman's citadel, and biblical sites like Mount Nebo. The country's compact size allows easy exploration, while Jordanian hospitality and safety make it accessible. Jordan's combination of ancient history, natural wonders, and authentic culture creates an unforgettable Middle Eastern experience.

---

name: OMAN
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

Oman enchants with its authentic Arabian character, dramatic landscapes, and warm hospitality. From Muscat's grand mosques and traditional souks to Nizwa's ancient forts, the Wahiba Sands' golden dunes to the Hajar Mountains' rugged beauty, Oman offers unspoiled natural wonders and rich cultural heritage. Experience genuine Arabian hospitality, explore wadis (valleys) with turquoise pools, and discover a nation that has preserved its traditions while embracing modernity.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Muscat  
**Currency:** Omani Rial (OMR)  
**Time Zone:** GST (UTC+4)  
**Driving Side:** Right  
**Calling Code:** +968  
**Best Season:** October-April  
**Languages:** Arabic, English widely spoken

### Tourism Summary

Oman attracts visitors with its authentic Arabian experiences, stunning natural diversity, and safety. Travelers explore Muscat's Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, Mutrah Souk, and coastal beauty, Nizwa's fort and traditional markets, Wahiba Sands' desert camps, and dramatic wadis perfect for swimming. The country's mountains, beaches, and deserts offer adventure, while Omani hospitality creates welcoming experiences.

---

## OMAN PACKAGES

packages.title: Muscat & Nizwa
packages.overview: Discover Oman's capital and historic interior on this cultural journey. Experience Muscat's blend of tradition and modernity, from the magnificent Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque to the atmospheric Mutrah Souk. Explore Nizwa's ancient fort, traditional markets, and mountain landscapes. This tour captures Oman's essence—authentic Arabian culture, stunning architecture, and warm hospitality.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Muscat
activities: Arrive in Muscat. Transfer to hotel. Evening Mutrah Corniche walk and souk exploration. Welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Muscat Highlights
activities: Morning: Visit Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, one of the world's most beautiful mosques with massive chandelier and Persian carpet. Royal Opera House exterior. Bait Al Zubair Museum.
Afternoon: Drive along coastal road. Visit Qurum Beach. Explore Mutrah Souk for frankincense, silver, and traditional goods.
Evening: Dinner at a seafood restaurant overlooking the Gulf of Oman.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Nizwa & Jebel Akhdar
activities: Morning: Drive to Nizwa (2 hours). Visit Nizwa Fort with its massive round tower. Explore the traditional souk, famous for silver handicrafts and dates.
Afternoon: Ascend Jebel Akhdar (Green Mountain) by 4x4. Visit terraced farms, rose gardens, and traditional villages. Stunning mountain views.
Evening: Overnight in mountain resort or return to Muscat.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Bahla & Wadis
activities: Morning: Visit Bahla Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Explore the ancient fortifications.
Afternoon: Wadi exploration - swim in natural pools surrounded by date palms and mountains. Options include Wadi Bani Khalid or Wadi Shab.
Evening: Return to Muscat. Farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Departure
activities: Transfer to Muscat airport.

name: AUSTRALIA
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

Australia amazes with its vast landscapes, unique wildlife, vibrant cities, and laid-back culture. From Sydney's iconic Opera House to the Great Barrier Reef's underwater wonders, the Outback's red deserts to Melbourne's cultural scene, Australia offers incredible diversity. Experience world-class beaches, ancient Aboriginal culture, cosmopolitan cities, and wildlife found nowhere else. The Australian spirit of adventure and "no worries" attitude creates an unforgettable journey down under.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Canberra  
**Currency:** Australian Dollar (AUD)  
**Time Zone:** Multiple (AEST UTC+10, ACST UTC+9.5, AWST UTC+8)  
**Driving Side:** Left  
**Calling Code:** +61  
**Best Season:** September-November (spring), March-May (fall)  
**Languages:** English

### Tourism Summary

Australia attracts visitors with Sydney's Harbour Bridge and Opera House, the Great Barrier Reef's diving and snorkeling, Melbourne's arts and coffee culture, Uluru's sacred rock, and the Gold Coast's beaches. The country's unique wildlife (kangaroos, koalas, wombats), diverse landscapes, and friendly locals create an adventure-filled destination combining natural wonders with modern cities.

---

## AUSTRALIA PACKAGES

packages.title: Sydney & Great Barrier Reef
packages.overview: Experience Australia's two most iconic destinations on this journey combining urban sophistication with natural wonder. Explore Sydney's world-famous landmarks, pristine beaches, and vibrant culture, then fly to tropical Cairns for Great Barrier Reef adventures. Snorkel among colorful coral, encounter marine life, and discover why Australia captivates travelers with its perfect blend of city excitement and natural beauty.
highlights: Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sydney
activities: Arrive in Sydney. Transfer to hotel. Evening walk around Circular Quay. Welcome dinner with harbour views.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Sydney Icons
activities: Morning: Guided tour of Sydney Opera House. Walk across Sydney Harbour Bridge or BridgeClimb experience. Explore The Rocks historic area.
Afternoon: Ferry to Manly Beach. Coastal walk or beach relaxation. Return ferry with harbour views.
Evening: Dinner in Darling Harbour.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Beaches & Coastal Walk
activities: Morning: Visit Bondi Beach, Australia's most famous beach. Bondi to Coogee coastal walk with stunning ocean views, beaches, and cliffs.
Afternoon: Explore Paddington's boutiques or Surry Hills' cafes. Visit Royal Botanic Gardens.
Evening: Sunset harbour cruise. Seafood dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Blue Mountains Day Trip
activities: Full-day excursion to Blue Mountains. See Three Sisters rock formation. Scenic World rides. Eucalyptus forest walks. Charming mountain villages. Return to Sydney.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Sydney to Cairns
activities: Morning: Final Sydney sightseeing or shopping.
Afternoon: Fly to Cairns (3 hours). Check into tropical resort. Evening exploring Cairns Esplanade.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Great Barrier Reef
activities: Full-day Great Barrier Reef cruise. Snorkel or dive among coral gardens. See tropical fish, sea turtles, and vibrant marine life. Multiple reef sites. Lunch on boat. Optional helicopter flight over the reef.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Rainforest & Leisure
activities: Morning: Visit Kuranda Rainforest. Skyrail Rainforest Cableway over canopy. Kuranda village markets and wildlife.
Afternoon: Return via scenic railway. Beach relaxation or optional activities (bungy jumping, white water rafting).
Evening: Farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Departure
activities: Transfer to Cairns airport for departure.

name: NEW ZEALAND
markdownContent:
### Country Overview

New Zealand captivates with its dramatic landscapes, adventure activities, and Maori culture. From the North Island's geothermal wonders to the South Island's fjords and mountains, New Zealand offers breathtaking scenery at every turn. Experience Queenstown's adrenaline activities, Milford Sound's majesty, Rotorua's geysers, and the Lord of the Rings filming locations. Kiwi friendliness and pristine nature create an outdoor paradise.

### Country Information

**Capital:** Wellington  
**Currency:** New Zealand Dollar (NZD)  
**Time Zone:** NZST (UTC+12)  
**Driving Side:** Left  
**Calling Code:** +64  
**Best Season:** December-February (summer), September-November (spring)  
**Languages:** English, Maori

### Tourism Summary

New Zealand attracts visitors with Queenstown's adventure capital status, Milford Sound's fjord beauty, Rotorua's geothermal activity and Maori culture, Auckland's harbors, and the stunning landscapes that made it Middle-earth. The country's compact size, diverse scenery, and outdoor activities create an adventure-filled destination.

---

## NEW ZEALAND PACKAGES

packages.title: New Zealand North & South Islands
packages.overview: Discover the best of both islands on this comprehensive New Zealand journey. Experience the North Island's geothermal wonders, Maori culture, and vibrant cities, then explore the South Island's dramatic mountains, fjords, and adventure capital. From Auckland to Queenstown, Rotorua to Milford Sound, this tour captures New Zealand's incredible diversity and natural beauty.
highlights: Rotorua geothermal parks and Maori culture

itinerary.title: Day 1-2: Auckland
activities: Arrive in Auckland. City tour including Sky Tower, harbour, and waterfront. Day trip to Waiheke Island for wine tasting and beaches.

itinerary.title: Day 3-4: Rotorua
activities: Drive to Rotorua. Visit geothermal parks (Wai-O-Tapu, Te Puia). See bubbling mud pools, geysers, and colorful hot springs. Maori cultural evening with hangi feast and performance. Optional: Hobbiton Movie Set tour.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Wellington
activities: Drive to Wellington. Interislander Ferry to South Island (scenic 3-hour crossing through Marlborough Sounds).

itinerary.title: Day 6-7: Queenstown
activities: Fly to Queenstown. Adventure activities: bungy jumping, jet boating, skydiving, or scenic gondola. Explore Arrowtown. Wine tasting in Gibbston Valley.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Milford Sound
activities: Full-day Milford Sound tour. Drive through stunning Fiordland scenery. Cruise the fjord seeing waterfalls, rainforest, and mountains. Possible dolphin and seal sightings.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Glacier Region
activities: Drive to Franz Josef or Fox Glacier. Glacier valley walks or helicopter flight. Explore West Coast rainforest.

itinerary.title: Day 10: Christchurch
activities: Drive to Christchurch. City tour. Punting on Avon River. Botanic Gardens.

itinerary.title: Day 11: Departure
activities: Transfer to Christchurch airport.
